conduct.chirper.title: Chirper Community Rules
conduct.chirper.intro: Before you start posting, please read the rules of the community.
conduct.chirper.allowed.title: What Is Allowed
conduct.chirper.sfw.title: Keep It SFW
conduct.chirper.sfw.lead: Chirper is a safe-for-work platform. Anything that could be considered more than that should be veiled. What is veiled?
conduct.chirper.sfw.4: Pictures with the focus on private/sensitive areas
conduct.chirper.notAllowed.title: What Is Not Allowed
conduct.chirper.notAllowed.6: Content that would ordinarily be on Velvet
conduct.chirper.ai.title: AI Usage
conduct.chirper.ai.body: We do not allow any content made by generative AI.
conduct.chirper.removalAppeal: If you believe your content was wrongfully removed, please contact support through a ticket on the Discord.
conduct.chirper.politics.title: No Real-World Politics
conduct.chirper.politics.body: Do not post real-world political content, such as elections, parties, politicians, governments, political campaigns, or debate on real-world political issues. Eorzean politics and lore are welcome.
conduct.chirper.respect.title: Be Respectful
conduct.chirper.respect.lead: Treat others with respect. Do not engage in:
conduct.chirper.respect.4: Impersonation of real people or misinformation intended to deceive
conduct.chirper.spam.title: No Spam or Advertising
conduct.chirper.spam.lead: Keep the feed worth browsing. Do not post:
conduct.chirper.spam.2: Venue, business, or service advertisements: use Yellow Pages instead
conduct.chirper.privacy.title: Protect Privacy
conduct.chirper.privacy.body: Do not share another person's personal information, private conversations, or confidential content without their permission.
conduct.chirper.creators.title: Respect Creators
conduct.chirper.creators.lead: Only upload content you have the right to share. Do not:
conduct.chirper.creators.2: Remove watermarks or repost commissioned work without permission
conduct.chirper.creators.3: Claim someone else's creations as your own
conduct.chirper.childSafety.title: Child Safety
conduct.chirper.childSafety.body: Any content involving or sexualizing child-like characters or minors is strictly prohibited, regardless of lore or stated age.
conduct.chirper.discretion.title: Moderator Discretion
conduct.chirper.discretion.body: Posts that are excessively suggestive, disruptive, or otherwise inappropriate for a public community may be removed at moderator discretion.

conduct.aethergram.intro: Before you start sharing photos, please read the rules of the community.
conduct.aethergram.allowed.title: What Is Allowed
conduct.aethergram.allowed.6: Romantic content that is not sexual in nature
conduct.aethergram.sfw.title: Keep It SFW

conduct.aethergram.irl.title: In-Game Content Only
conduct.aethergram.irl.body: Aethergram is a place for in-game moments. Do not post real-life photographs or other real-world content. Memes are the exception.
conduct.aethergram.politics.title: No Real-World Politics
conduct.aethergram.politics.body: Do not post real-world political content, such as elections, parties, politicians, governments, political campaigns, or debate on real-world political issues. Eorzean politics and lore are welcome.
conduct.aethergram.respect.title: Be Respectful
conduct.aethergram.respect.lead: Treat others with respect. Do not engage in:
conduct.aethergram.respect.4: Harassment through edited or manipulated images
conduct.aethergram.respect.5: Impersonation of real people or misinformation intended to deceive
conduct.aethergram.spam.title: No Spam or Advertising

conduct.aethergram.childlike.title: Child-like Characters
conduct.aethergram.childlike.body: Any content that sexualizes characters with child-like appearances or proportions is strictly prohibited, regardless of lore or stated age. Kitten Modded characters are not allowed.
conduct.aethergram.discretion.title: Moderator Discretion
conduct.aethergram.discretion.body: Moderators will consider the overall context and intent. Content that appears intended to be sexually suggestive or otherwise inappropriate for a safe-for-work platform may be removed at moderator discretion.
conduct.velvet.adults.title: Adults Only (18+)
conduct.velvet.adults.body: Velvet is for adults aged 18 and above. Any content involving minors, child-like characters (including Lalafell and Kitten Mods), or underage roleplay is strictly prohibited. It is removed, and the account is suspended, up to and including a permanent ban.
conduct.velvet.allowed.title: What Is Allowed
conduct.velvet.allowed.1: Personal ads looking for mature roleplay
conduct.velvet.limits.title: Content Limits
conduct.velvet.limits.lead: Velvet is an adult space, but some content is still off-limits:
conduct.velvet.limits.1: Animal genitalia, including animal genitals on humanoid or beast-race characters
conduct.velvet.consent.title: Consent First
conduct.velvet.consent.lead: Respect other users. Do not engage in:
conduct.velvet.consent.3: Contacting users who have declined or blocked you
conduct.velvet.boundaries.title: Respect Boundaries
conduct.velvet.boundaries.lead: Only interact through intended platform features. Do not:
conduct.velvet.boundaries.2: Use alternate accounts to evade blocks
conduct.velvet.boundaries.3: Ask others to contact someone on your behalf
conduct.velvet.illegal.title: Illegal and Prohibited Content
conduct.velvet.illegal.lead: Zero tolerance, and fantasy or roleplay is no exemption. Any of the following is removed, and the account is suspended, up to and including a permanent ban:
conduct.velvet.illegal.3: Non-consensual intimate imagery or revenge porn
conduct.velvet.illegal.4: Deepfake or AI-generated explicit images of real people
conduct.velvet.illegal.7: Sexualized violence, snuff, or extreme gore
conduct.velvet.privacy.title: Protect Privacy
conduct.velvet.privacy.lead: Doxxing is removed, and the account is suspended, up to and including a permanent ban. Never share another person's personal information without permission, including:

conduct.velvet.respect.title: Be Respectful

conduct.velvet.respect.5: Impersonation of real people or misinformation intended to deceive
conduct.velvet.moderation.title: Respect Moderation
conduct.velvet.moderation.body: Do not evade bans, create alternate accounts to avoid enforcement, or harass moderators. Appeals are welcome if made respectfully.

conduct.muster.discretion.title: Moderator Discretion

settings.title: Settings
settings.liveGlassHint: Glass inside apps blurs what is really behind the phone instead of the app colour. Uses a little GPU time every frame; turn it off if the game stutters.
settings.vibrationHint: The phone shakes briefly when a notification arrives.
settings.quietWhileBusyHint: Hold banners, sound and vibration during combat, duties, cutscenes and loading. Notifications still arrive.
settings.showNotificationBannerHint: Display banner notifications at the top of the screen.
settings.lockPositionHint: The phone stays where you put it, and dragging inside it scrolls instead of moving the window.
settings.marketContextMenuHint: Shows "Search the Market" option in the in-game context menu when right-clicking on an item.
settings.linkpearlContextMenuHint: Shows "Open a Linkpearl chat" option in the in-game context menu when right-clicking on a player.
settings.scrollWhileIdleHint: When you open your phone and stand still, your character scrolls through it (Tomescroll emote). Move or cancel the emote and it stays off until you open the phone again. Does nothing if you haven't unlocked the emote.
settings.showInGposeHint: Keep the phone available while you're in Group Pose, so you can open it during photo shoots. Turn it off to keep your screen clear for screenshots.
settings.nativeFileDialogHint: Pick photos and sounds with the Windows file browser. Turn it off if importing a file crashes your game.
settings.showSensitiveHint: Photos marked sensitive stay covered until you tap them. Turn this on to see them straight away.
settings.startupHint: Open the phone automatically when you log in. Open minimized shows it as a small dock that you tap to expand.
onboarding.searchTourBody: Tap Search, or pull down on an empty spot of the Home Screen, to find apps, contacts, settings, notes and market items in one place.
settings.gameSoundsHint: Sound effects in the arcade mini-games.
settings.silentModeHint: Mutes the ringtone, notifications, and interface sounds in one tap. Media keeps playing.
settings.ringtoneHint: Play a ringtone when a call comes in.
settings.notificationSoundsHint: Play a sound when a notification arrives.
settings.uiSoundsHint: Short sounds for key moments: waking the phone, taking a photo, sending a message, earning coins.
settings.uiSoundExtrasHint: Extra feedback for frequent interactions. Turn off any that feel noisy.

settings.testServerHint: Beta builds talk to the Aethernet test server, which keeps its own accounts, messages and posts. Turn this off to use the live server instead. Switching signs you out, so you sign in again on the other server.

Messages from encrypted chats are decrypted on this PC first and sent to Aethernet as readable text for translation. Translations of public content are cached without recording who asked. Translations of private messages are never stored.
changelog.r0999.0: Added seven phone cases: Atomos, Baby Bat, Dwarf Rabbit, Enkidu, Horror, Kupo, and Runic, contributed by Remi and Silkie
changelog.r0999.1: Every phone case was recompressed, so the plugin downloads at less than half its old size even with the seven new cases
changelog.r0999.2: A message now appears in an open conversation the moment it arrives, instead of waiting for the next refresh
changelog.r0999.3: Opening a conversation, or coming back to one you left open, now pulls the newest messages straight away
changelog.r0999.4: Chat now says when it cannot reach the server and offers a retry, instead of quietly showing an old transcript
changelog.r0999.5: Landscape now runs the hardware buttons along the top and bottom edges and keeps the screen the size it has in portrait, contributed by Raya
changelog.r0999.6: Photo pickers now draw only the thumbnails you can see, so opening one with a large library no longer stalls, contributed by BluntEXE
changelog.r0999.7: A shortcut icon borrowed from another plugin now fills the tile all the way to its rounded edge
changelog.r0999.8: Housing filter chips no longer wrap their labels, and the filter drawer rows sit on the standard spacing, contributed by Chaosvanguard
changelog.r0999.9: Fixed one refused request pausing all the others: an upload stopped by the request limit no longer holds back sends and refreshes
changelog.r0999.10: Fixed the Doman Enclave daily reporting your whole allowance as outstanding, ignoring what you had already donated, contributed by Farroness
changelog.r0999.11: Fixed the venue website link falling back to a page that does not exist on FFXIV Venues, contributed by Raya
changelog.r0999.12: Fixed the case artwork rotating the wrong way in landscape and leaving a hairline gap along the edge of the phone, contributed by Raya
changelog.r0999.13: Fixed the German wording for the physical ranged role, two game names, and a Dailies tour card, contributed by Silkie
changelog.r0999.14: Home folders now hold shortcuts as well as apps, so a plugin launcher can be dragged in and grouped like any other icon, contributed by K.I.R.O
changelog.r0998.0: Added Housing, a new app that browses every housing ward on a map, tracks the plots you are watching, and reminds you before a lottery entry period closes, contributed by Chaosvanguard
changelog.r0998.1: Added Community Radio to Music, with more details coming soon
changelog.r0998.2: Added new phone cases, contributed by Silkie, Zivyl, Remi, and Rania
changelog.r0998.3: Badges have been completely reworked: they are now granted or earned under certain conditions, with the details on the Discord server
changelog.r0998.4: A fullscreen photo can be popped out into an ordinary window with a title bar, resized freely, and named after the app it came from
changelog.r0998.5: A photo can be filed into an album from the viewer, without leaving for the album first
changelog.r0998.6: The market now shows what lands in your retainer after tax, and names the city with the lowest rate
changelog.r0998.7: When another world, data center, or region sells an item cheaper, the Prices card names it and its price
changelog.r0998.8: An item that only sells HQ now opens on the HQ tab instead of an empty NQ one
changelog.r0998.9: Hovering a market row reveals the full item name, so families such as Ballroom Etiquette are no longer indistinguishable
changelog.r0998.10: Calls gained a Speaker picker, so a call plays through the output device you choose instead of always following the system default
changelog.r0998.11: Quiet While Busy holds banners, sounds, and shakes during combat, duties, cutscenes, and zoning; the notification still arrives and still counts as unread
changelog.r0998.12: Notification toasts can be turned off globally or per app, contributed by Radvo
changelog.r0998.13: An alarm whose minute passed while the plugin was unloaded now still fires, within a ten minute catch-up window
changelog.r0998.14: Every chat app now keeps a draft per conversation, so what you wrote for one person no longer follows you into the next
changelog.r0998.15: Velvet can pass on a profile, which drops them for the session without blocking them
changelog.r0998.16: Leaving the Velvet profile editor with unsaved changes now asks before discarding them
changelog.r0998.17: A Velvet profile you have already reported no longer offers the flag again
changelog.r0998.18: Dragging an icon past the last Home Screen page now opens a new page
changelog.r0998.19: Escape now backs out of the topmost thing on screen: a confirmation, the report sheet, the share sheet, then Control Center
changelog.r0998.20: Control Center can be pulled open by dragging the status band down, not only by tapping it
changelog.r0998.21: The community rules unlock their accept button once you have read to the end, instead of after a fixed countdown
changelog.r0998.22: Dock icons now raise the same name pill as the rest of the Home Screen
changelog.r0998.23: Removing an app from the Home Screen now asks first
changelog.r0998.24: Dalamud's settings button beside the plugin now opens the phone on the Settings app
changelog.r0998.25: A shortcut can use any plugin's icon, picked from the appearance sheet
changelog.r0998.26: Copying a chat bubble, a Linkpearl line, or a travel command now shows a confirmation, so a copy is no longer silent
changelog.r0998.27: An album's rename and delete are now reachable from a menu button on the card, not only by right-click
changelog.r0998.28: Empty screens now offer the next step: an empty photo library offers Camera, and Velvet offers Clear filters when your own filters are hiding everyone
changelog.r0998.29: A list that failed to load now says so and offers Retry, instead of reading as an empty list
changelog.r0998.30: Camera remembers the grid and the flash, and Photos reopens on the tab you left
changelog.r0998.31: The emoji picker takes the caret when it opens, so you can type to search instead of hunting the grid
changelog.r0998.32: Games that run on a clock now show a Paused veil when the phone loses focus, instead of looking frozen
changelog.r0998.33: The battery icon warns as a whole below twenty percent and breathes below ten, rather than tinting the fill alone
changelog.r0998.34: An empty inbox now offers New message instead of only describing itself
changelog.r0998.35: About gained a Copy Support Info row that puts versions, OS, language, and sound state on the clipboard, carrying no account or character identifiers
changelog.r0998.36: Fixed encryption and imported WAV and MP3 playback on Linux and Wine, contributed by Ehno
changelog.r0998.37: Fixed a message the game rejects disappearing in silence: the text stays in the box and the phone says the send failed
changelog.r0998.38: Fixed the housing translations: every language now uses the wording its own game client uses, and district names are translated
changelog.r0998.39: Fixed the calendar starting its week on Sunday in the five languages whose week starts on Monday
changelog.r0998.40: Fixed mini-games running on while the phone was not focused, and Tetris and Sudoku taking the keyboard while you were typing in the game
changelog.r0998.41: Fixed Settings showing badges you no longer hold
changelog.r0998.42: Fixed screens collapsing onto the avatar while a profile photo had not loaded yet, most visibly in the Velvet profile editor
changelog.r0998.43: Fixed the photo viewer's buttons stacking up over the photo
changelog.r0998.44: Fixed the Yellow Pages ad form cutting off its failure message instead of wrapping it, contributed by Raya
changelog.r0998.45: Moved the Velvet photo gallery below the profile details, contributed by Farroness
changelog.r0998.46: Fixed the emote idle scroll firing while an event window was open, contributed by Chaosvanguard
changelog.r0998.47: Fixed Escape doing nothing when the phone had been opened with a slash command
changelog.r0998.48: Fixed the app badge counting the conversation you are currently reading
changelog.r0998.49: Fixed blocking someone in Velvet leaving them in the Discover deck
changelog.r0998.50: Fixed Block on a Velvet profile acting without asking first
changelog.r0998.51: Fixed a blocking moderation notice vanishing for good once dismissed: it now leaves a notification behind
changelog.r0998.52: Fixed two notification settings showing in English in every translated language
changelog.r0998.53: Notifications no longer appear at the title screen, where there is no session to act on them
changelog.r0997.0: Added Shortcuts, a new app that turns a run of commands into a single tap and pins it to the home screen
changelog.r0997.1: You can now resize the phone by dragging the bottom right corner of its frame
changelog.r0997.2: Phone Size in Settings is a slider now, so you can pick any size instead of six fixed ones
changelog.r0997.3: The whole screen scales with the phone, so text and icons grow with it instead of staying small
changelog.r0997.4: Text Size is a slider too now, and it goes down to 70 percent for people who want smaller text
changelog.r0997.5: Accent is a full color picker now, so you can use any color you like instead of the five presets
changelog.r0997.6: Ringtone volume and notification volume are sliders now, so you can pick any level instead of four fixed steps
changelog.r0997.7: The minimized phone now stays the same size whatever size the phone itself is
changelog.r0997.8: Fixed notifications coming back after you cleared them, and badges staying lit after everything had been read
changelog.r0997.9: Fixed taps in the Control Center doing nothing while a menu or picker was open in the app behind it
changelog.r0996.0: You can now link your Patreon account from the account section in Settings
changelog.r0996.1: Linking grants your member perks automatically, including the Patreon member badge, and they follow your membership as it changes
changelog.r0996.2: Settings shows whether your membership is active once linked, and you can unlink Patreon at any time
changelog.r0995.0: The phone has a new body: a machined metal frame and a glass band, with one curve shared by the screen, the glass, and every case
changelog.r0995.1: Cases are now hand-painted art instead of flat tints, starting with Titanium and Silkie; the Silkie design was made by Nui
changelog.r0995.2: Case art can spill past the edge of the phone, and it stays visible while the phone is minimized
changelog.r0995.3: The phone now ships with its own ringtones and notification sounds, and calls and notifications each pick from their own library
changelog.r0995.4: Accounts can now carry badges such as Verified, Support, Contributor, and Patreon member, shown as a glyph and a colored name across the social apps, each with its own animated effect; more information about badges will be shared in the near future
changelog.r0995.5: Settings lists your badges under your account, and you can unequip any badge you would rather not show
changelog.r0995.6: Reporting a message now attaches its photo or voice note to the report as evidence
changelog.r0995.7: Posts, comments, and stories removed by moderation now disappear from every phone right away
changelog.r0995.8: A suspension now locks only the social apps; the rest of the phone keeps working
changelog.r0995.9: Comments, galleries, likers, story viewers, inboxes, and other long lists now load more as you scroll instead of stopping at the first batch
changelog.r0995.10: A Velvet post's audience can be changed after posting, from the menu on the post
changelog.r0995.11: The Support Aetherphone button in Settings moved under the account section
changelog.r0995.12: Fixed an issue where old tags could still be seen on Velvet profiles
changelog.r0995.13: Tags that are no longer offered now appear as removable chips when you edit your Velvet profile, so you can clear them off
changelog.r0995.14: Fixed an issue where notifications could stop appearing, or could not be dismissed or turned off
changelog.r0995.15: Fixed tapping a notification doing nothing when its app was already open
changelog.r0995.16: Fixed conversations being marked as read while you were not looking at them
changelog.r0995.17: Fixed profiles showing an outdated copy: they now refresh every time you open one
changelog.r0995.18: Fixed the Velvet profile editor staying open after a save and saying nothing when saving failed
changelog.r0995.19: Fixed a freshly created Velvet post not showing in your profile gallery until the next refresh
changelog.r0995.20: Fixed Discover cards in Velvet stacking on top of each other
changelog.r0995.21: Fixed the Velvet request count lagging behind and counting requests it could not show
changelog.r0995.22: Fixed Yellow Pages inquiry notifications not opening the conversation
changelog.r0995.23: Fixed clicks passing through one window into whatever sat behind it, contributed by Ehno
changelog.r0995.24: Fixed taps leaking through the emoji picker, mention popups, and report categories to the buttons underneath
changelog.r0995.25: Fixed cut-off text, hover scrolling, and overlapping layouts across many screens, contributed by Ehno
changelog.r0995.26: Fixed the Jobs header shifting when the categories button hides, with long titles scrolling instead of clipping, contributed by Ehno
changelog.r0995.27: Fixed very large images being able to exhaust memory: images are now checked and capped before they are decoded, contributed by BluntEXE
changelog.r0995.28: Fixed long confirmation popup titles being cut off instead of wrapping
changelog.r0995.29: Fixed icons sitting slightly off-center in round buttons
changelog.r0995.30: The network now gives every account far more headroom, so sending several messages in a row no longer trips a rate limit
changelog.r0995.31: A rare network pause now lasts seconds instead of minutes
changelog.r0995.32: A small capsule under the clock counts down any network pause, so the phone never goes quiet without saying why
changelog.r0994.0: Fixed apps closing the instant you opened them and returning you to the home screen while you were signed out
changelog.r0994.1: Fixed Settings closing the same way, which had left no way to sign back in; you can now open Settings and sign in again
changelog.r0993.0: Stopped the phone from making any network requests while you are signed out, including the background retries that used to run from the title screen
changelog.r0993.1: Fixed photos and voice notes that fail to load retrying nonstop; the phone now waits a couple of minutes before trying again
changelog.r0993.2: Fixed Velvet comments wrapping their text at the wrong width
changelog.r0992.0: Fixed the view count on Yellow Pages ads, which always stayed at zero, so opening an ad now counts as a view
changelog.r0992.1: Added a menu to every post in Velvet, in the feed and on the post itself, so you can open it, report it, block whoever posted it, or delete your own
changelog.r0992.2: Rebuilt the profile page in Chirper and Aethergram: the name and handle now sit beside the photo, the buttons share a single row, and the empty gaps are gone
changelog.r0992.3: Removed one more suggested tag from Velvet, so it no longer shows up when you edit your profile or tag a post
changelog.r0992.4: Brought back the Windows file browser when you pick a photo or a sound, so it remembers your folders and shows thumbnails again
changelog.r0992.5: Added a switch in Settings under Behavior that swaps it for a simple browser inside the phone, which turns itself on if picking a file could crash your game
changelog.r0992.6: Split the Immersion settings in two, so the window, screenshot, and startup options now live on a new Behavior page
changelog.r0991.0: Removed a few suggested tags from Velvet, so they no longer appear when you edit your profile or tag a post
changelog.r0990.0: Added the App Store, a new app where you browse every app on the phone by category, install the ones you want, and remove the ones you do not, with a product page for each
changelog.r0990.1: Added Muster, a new app for meetups where you post a live announcement with your in-game location, start time, and duration, browse what is happening on your data center, RSVP, travel there in one tap, and keep everyone posted with quick updates; invites can be sent into any chat
changelog.r0990.2: Added Yellow Pages, a new classifieds board where you post a place, a service, or a call for people, with photos, a housing address, opening hours, and end-to-end encrypted inquiries; ads renew, expire on their own, and share into any chat as a card
changelog.r0990.3: Added Announcements, a new app where news from the team lands on every phone as a banner, a notification, and an unread badge
changelog.r0990.4: Added Jobs, a new app that lists your classes by role, switches to a gearset with one tap, and lets you sort your gearsets into your own categories, contributed by K.I.R.O
changelog.r0990.5: Added Health, a new app that tracks your character's activity: estimated steps and distance on foot, swimming, active time, hydration reminders, goals, history, streaks, and personal records, contributed by YozoraCho
changelog.r0990.6: Games adds seven titles: Sudoku, Chess against the phone, Stack, Crystal Drop, Beat, Blade Throw, and Trivia
changelog.r0990.7: The Games launcher now leads with a daily challenge and counts your streak
changelog.r0990.8: Aethergram gets direct messages: an inbox in the top bar, replies, reactions, edits, voice notes, typing indicators, read receipts, and a Message button on profiles
changelog.r0990.9: Messages from strangers land in a separate Requests tab with no notification and no read receipts until you accept, and a conversation can be deleted for your side only
changelog.r0990.10: Aethergram posts can be sent into a chat with the paper plane, to several people at once
changelog.r0990.11: Aethergram stories now chain the way Instagram does, and you can reply to one with a message or a quick reaction that lands in the chat with the story attached
changelog.r0990.12: Accounts can be private: follows become requests you confirm or delete, they get their own row at the top of Activity, and people who do not follow you see a locked grid
changelog.r0990.13: Posts can be saved with a bookmark and found again in a Saved grid on your own profile
changelog.r0990.14: Profiles show a Followed by line built from people you both follow, and a Follows you chip next to the handle
changelog.r0990.15: Aethergram and Velvet posts can now be portrait or landscape, not only square
changelog.r0990.16: You can share your in-game location in a ChocoChat, Velvet, or Aethergram chat, and tapping the card drops a map flag
changelog.r0990.17: Chirper reactions are now full color emoji, seven of them new, and they sit in their own row under a post instead of being cut off after the third
changelog.r0990.18: Velvet's Discover filters are now a full-screen editor covering every part of a profile, with chips that cycle through neutral, include, and exclude, and new tone, pace, and style tags
changelog.r0990.19: Velvet's profile fields were rebuilt: eight genders you can pick more than one of, a new sexuality field, IRL and non-IRL intents, a flat role list, a separate kinks card, plain subject tags for limits, and poly, with no twelve-selection cap
changelog.r0990.20: Velvet's Feed tab has an Everyone and Connections switch, and each post can go to your connections only or to everyone
changelog.r0990.21: Velvet profile galleries are real now: people you are connected to see the grid, and strangers see how many photos are locked
changelog.r0990.22: The lock button in Velvet and Aethergram opens a real encryption screen, a locked chat shows a banner that takes you straight to recovery code entry, and the phone nudges you to save a code if you have none
changelog.r0990.23: Settings lists every Aethernet account stored on this phone and switches between them with one tap, so playing an alt no longer takes your main's handle, number, and chats off the phone
changelog.r0990.24: The Camera hides nameplates in your photos, contributed by K.I.R.O
changelog.r0990.25: The Camera also hides hotbars, the chat log, and target info while the shutter fires, and puts back exactly what it hid
changelog.r0990.26: The Camera has a rotate button that turns the phone sideways, so wide shots save as genuinely wide photos
changelog.r0990.27: Screenshots you take in game are imported into Photos automatically, including ReShade and GShade ones; the toggle is in Settings under Immersion
changelog.r0990.28: Photos gets custom albums and a button that opens the photos folder on your PC, contributed by Syrilai
changelog.r0990.29: Photos gets a share button that sends a photo into a chat, sets it as your wallpaper, or hands it to Aethergram or Velvet to post
changelog.r0990.30: Skywatcher gets a Control tab that overrides the zone's weather and the Eorzean clock, with a scrub track across the day, Dawn, Noon, Dusk, and Midnight presets, and every weather the zone can roll; it is cosmetic and only you see it
changelog.r0990.31: Settings, Appearance now offers ten phone cases: Titanium, Graphite, Silver, Gold, Rose, Midnight, Jade, Coral, Lavender, and Porcelain
changelog.r0990.32: Folders can be tinted with the phone's accent colors and scroll instead of running out of room, contributed by K.I.R.O
changelog.r0990.33: The labels under Home Screen icons can be hidden with a Show App Names toggle, contributed by BluntEXE
changelog.r0990.34: Every scrolling surface on the phone now scrolls like a phone: drag with momentum, pull down to refresh, and a fling never fires the button under your finger, contributed by Valiice
changelog.r0990.35: Aetherphone now honors Dalamud's Reduce Motion setting and settles its animations instantly when it is on
changelog.r0990.36: The phone now follows your 12 or 24-hour clock preference everywhere, and picks the format your language implies if you never touch the setting, contributed by K.I.R.O
changelog.r0990.37: Music gains favorite radio stations, contributed by Hubkaw
changelog.r0990.38: The App Store product page names the developer behind each app, contributed by YozoraCho
changelog.r0990.39: Aethergram has its own settings screen behind a gear on your profile, carrying the Who can message you choice
changelog.r0990.40: Chirper now pages through a profile's whole chirp history instead of stopping after the first page
changelog.r0990.41: Every notification type has its own badge icon, rechirp notifications quote the chirp, and repost and quote notifications take you to the post
changelog.r0990.42: Each social app pulls its own activity feed, with older notifications loading as you scroll
changelog.r0990.43: Chirper and Aethergram stopped polling the feed every 25 seconds and have a refresh button instead
changelog.r0990.44: Tap the Aethergram home tab or the Chirper title to jump the feed back to the top and refresh it, contributed by K.I.R.O
changelog.r0990.45: The community rules are rewritten: every app has its own sectioned rule set with a What Is Allowed list, and Muster and Yellow Pages carry their own
changelog.r0990.46: The community rules can be reopened from inside Aethergram, Chirper, and Velvet at any time, contributed by K.I.R.O
changelog.r0990.47: Velvet is unavailable on Lalafell characters and now explains why on screen instead of quietly vanishing
changelog.r0990.91: Aethernet's security has been strengthened, with tighter protections around your account and everything the phone keeps for you
changelog.r0990.92: Several security weaknesses in Chirper, Aethergram, and Velvet were found and fixed, contributed by SHIGYL
changelog.r0990.49: Searching for people now needs at least four letters and matches from the start of a name, so nobody can sweep the search box to collect profiles
changelog.r0990.50: New accounts no longer take your character name as their display name or handle; you pick your own while setting up the phone
changelog.r0990.51: A muster host's character name and world stay hidden until you RSVP
changelog.r0990.52: Removing an account from the phone keeps its encryption key on the device, so signing back in still opens your old chats
changelog.r0990.53: Sign-in failures now explain themselves: brand-new characters can take a day to appear on the Lodestone, Chinese and Korean servers cannot be verified there, and the Lodestone throttles at peak hours
changelog.r0990.54: Skywatcher's panels are rebuilt as frosted cards with real depth and every weather glyph sits in its own sky chip, fixing gray text on gray backgrounds in fog and clouds
changelog.r0990.55: The Clock app and its widget follow a time override
changelog.r0990.56: Flow is rebuilt on rectangular boards that use the whole screen, with Easy, Medium, and Hard tiers that each keep their own best
changelog.r0990.57: Home Screen icons stay in the exact spot you drop them, gaps and all
changelog.r0990.58: The Home Screen wallpaper follows your Light or Dark theme instead of the real-world clock, and crossfades when you switch
changelog.r0990.59: Uninstalling an app now stops all of its background work and notifications at once and takes its widgets off the Home Screen with it
changelog.r0990.60: The About window is gone, replaced by a Support Aetherphone button at the bottom of Settings
changelog.r0990.61: The Skywatcher, Calendar, Clock, Timers, and Activity Home Screen widgets were reworked at every size, contributed by BluntEXE
changelog.r0990.62: Collections reads your unlocks from the game itself, so it works without waiting on an external site and no longer misses race-specific hairstyles, contributed by Syrilai
changelog.r0990.63: Dailies replaced Notify when tasks reset with a Show badge toggle
changelog.r0990.64: New messages in an open chat now arrive in about a second instead of waiting for the next poll
changelog.r0990.65: The phone now asks for far less over the network: unchanged checks cost a few hundred bytes, responses are compressed, and it backs off properly when the server asks it to
changelog.r0990.66: Social feeds no longer grow without bound while you scroll
changelog.r0990.67: Fixed encrypted chats becoming unreadable after a sign-out or a character switch by keeping your keys instead of dropping them
changelog.r0990.68: Fixed the phone binding your profile to the wrong Lodestone character, which could show a stranger's portrait as yours
changelog.r0990.69: Fixed Velvet still showing the previous character's profile, connections, feed, and chats after switching to an alt
changelog.r0990.70: Fixed the phone going unreachable while it was closed or calls were turned off, which silenced chat and social alerts
changelog.r0990.71: Fixed Light mode inking apps that paint their own background, which turned chat bubbles and headers black
changelog.r0990.72: Fixed a large sweep of text overflow: labels that were cut off or drawn over their neighbours now scroll when you hover them, across Chirper, Velvet, Aethergram, Market, Collections, Inventory, Fishing, Notifications, Activity, Settings, and the Messages, Music, Maps, and Linkpearl rows, contributed by BluntEXE
changelog.r0990.73: Fixed emoji in Chirper posts merging into each other and overlapping the line above, contributed by BluntEXE
changelog.r0990.74: Fixed Enter posting instead of picking the highlighted person while you tag someone, and the suggestion list opening on top of the home button
changelog.r0990.75: Fixed hyphenated words and the accent color swatches running past the edge of their panel
changelog.r0990.76: Fixed taps landing on the row instead of the button inside it, on Maps and Venues favorite stars, Music playlist buttons, story rings in the feeds, Velvet's accept, decline, and unblock, and unstarring a message
changelog.r0990.77: Fixed the media control's Stop and Previous buttons overlapping, so one tap could fire both, contributed by BluntEXE
changelog.r0990.78: Fixed Control Center modules you removed coming back after a restart, contributed by BluntEXE
changelog.r0990.79: Fixed Control Center opening on top of the Camera
changelog.r0990.80: Fixed the Photos viewer letterboxing inside the app margins instead of filling the screen, and the previous and next arrows pointing the wrong way
changelog.r0990.81: Fixed Skywatcher disagreeing with the game about the current weather inside duties, cutscenes, and weather-locked zones, and a moon showing on a daytime window
changelog.r0990.82: Fixed every non-English client falling back to the same cloud palette, glyph, and ambience regardless of the real weather
changelog.r0990.83: Fixed songs sticking on Buffering forever and thumbnails failing to load on Linux and Wine, contributed by BluntEXE
changelog.r0990.84: Fixed the game crashing under Wine while the phone sampled its signal bars, contributed by K.I.R.O
changelog.r0990.85: Fixed the wrong roulette being marked as done in Dailies, contributed by Syrilai
changelog.r0990.86: Fixed Flow tubes detaching on a fast drag, and levels that looked finished but never ended
changelog.r0990.87: Fixed Bubbles refusing to pop matching bubbles after a new row, never ending a game, and shots drifting off the aim preview after a wall bounce
changelog.r0990.88: Fixed the idle Tomescroll animation stealing back an emote you played yourself
changelog.r0990.89: Fixed the phone crashing the game for ReShade users when picking a picture from the PC
changelog.r0990.90: Fixed the phone forgetting where you left it on screen after closing the game
changelog.r0989.0: Velvet is now hidden on Lalafell characters while a community poll on the matter gathers votes
changelog.r0988.0: Chirper now lets you rechirp a post so your followers see it, or quote it to add your own thoughts above the original
changelog.r0988.1: Velvet profiles now have a gender field, and Discover has a matching filter so you can choose how you appear and narrow who you see
changelog.r0988.2: Velvet now asks for your gender while you set up your profile, so you can be found from the moment you join
changelog.r0988.3: Chirper, Aethergram, and Velvet now show the community guidelines the first time you open each one, so the ground rules are clear before you post
changelog.r0988.4: If a character is banned, the phone now shows a full-screen notice with the reason
changelog.r0988.5: You now get a notification when a moderator sends you a warning or updates one of your reports
changelog.r0988.6: Music now has a repeat mode, so you can loop the current song or your whole queue
changelog.r0988.7: Calls now let you know clearly when one is declined, goes unanswered, or drops
changelog.r0985.3: Aetherphone now has full-color emoji: tap the new emoji button to add them to your chats, posts, and comments, and they render inline right where you type
changelog.r0985.4: Aetherphone now gives each character its own social accounts: switch characters in game and the social apps sign out, ready for you to sign in as whoever you are playing
changelog.r0985.5: Your encrypted chats can now move with you: save a recovery code and use it to restore them when you sign in on a new device
changelog.r0985.6: Fixed the Doman Enclave restoration showing up as a daily in Dailies; it now tracks on its weekly reset
changelog.r0985.7: Fixed the sample notification from the /phone test command refusing to clear from the notification center
changelog.r0987.0: Photos and avatars now load faster: images are cached on your device instead of being downloaded again every time you scroll
changelog.r0987.3: After hearing your concerns, we have completely removed anonymous usage analytics for everyone; Aetherphone no longer collects any analytics at all, so feel free to use the phone all you like
changelog.r0987.4: We have removed AI moderation completely; your posts and comments are no longer reviewed by AI
changelog.r0987.6: Removed the KupoAI app from the phone; there are no longer any AI features in Aetherphone
changelog.r0987.5: Moderation is now handled through your reports, with new protections added to the report system, and people who act inappropriately will now receive a warning
changelog.r0987.2: When moderation removes one of your comments, the notification now says it was a comment and gives the reason
changelog.r0986.0: Fixed a connection issue with the server, so the phone now stays connected more reliably
changelog.r0985.0: Velvet's Discover filters now include a region, so you can narrow the people you see to NA, EU, JP, or OCE
changelog.r0985.1: Linkpearl now has a bell button on the Chats tab that pauses every chat and linkshell notification at once, and turns them back on when you tap it again
changelog.r0985.2: Fixed search in Velvet so you can find people by name, handle, or the tags on their profile
changelog.r0984.0: KupoAI is in maintenance and is hidden from the phone for now; it will return in a later update with smarter, more intelligent answers
changelog.r0983.0: Music now has playlists: create your own, add songs from Now Playing or search, and play, rename, or delete them whenever you like
changelog.r0983.1: The phone can now stay open during Group Pose for photo shoots, with a new Show in Group Pose toggle in Settings under Immersion
changelog.r0983.2: Velvet's Discover list now keeps loading more people as you scroll, instead of stopping after the first page
changelog.r0983.3: A warm welcome to all our new Brazilian friends: Aetherphone now speaks Português (Brasil)
changelog.r0983.4: Fixed Music, ringtones, and call audio turning down the whole game's volume and leaving it lowered; the phone now keeps its own volume separate from the game
changelog.r0983.5: Fixed Chinese and Japanese text running off the right edge of the screen instead of wrapping onto the next line
changelog.r0982.0: Fixed sending a photo or voice note in a chat sometimes failing to go through
changelog.r0982.1: Fixed a post removed by moderation still showing in your feed until you reloaded the phone
changelog.r0982.2: Fixed long names in the story tray overlapping the tiles beside them
changelog.r0982.3: Fixed image feeds shaking, and their photos and text reflowing, while you scrolled or moved between screens
changelog.r0981.0: Fixed the Discord link so it now opens the current server
changelog.r0980.0: Activity is now a daily tracker: close your rings as you clear roulettes and duties, keep a history of your streaks, and watch a home widget fill up through the day
changelog.r0980.1: Dailies has been rebuilt around gradient cards and now fills itself in, detecting the roulettes and hunt bills you have already done
changelog.r0980.2: The Photos gallery has been rebuilt with a day-by-day library, smart month albums, and a full-screen viewer
changelog.r0980.3: Collections has been redrawn with colored category tiles and glass cards to match the rest of the phone
changelog.r0980.4: Inventory has been redrawn with colored source tiles and glass cards to match the rest of the phone
changelog.r0980.5: Wallet has been redrawn with the same gradient-card look as the rest of the phone
changelog.r0980.6: Fishing has been rebuilt in the phone's gradient look and now carries the Ruby Route schedule alongside Indigo
changelog.r0980.7: Music now starts a song the instant you tap it, instead of waiting for the whole track to load, and its search now reaches long mixes and full albums
changelog.r0980.8: Music radio can now be filtered by country and language and sorted, making it easier to find something to listen to
changelog.r0980.9: Velvet's feed is now a full post-card timeline, on par with Aethergram and Chirper
changelog.r0980.10: Photos and voice notes you send in ChocoChat or Velvet are now end-to-end encrypted, the same way your messages already were
changelog.r0980.11: You can now rename a saved contact in ChocoChat
changelog.r0980.12: About now links to the Aetherphone Discord and website
changelog.r0980.15: You can now block someone from the phone, and a block now holds everywhere: they leave your chats, they can no longer show up on your posts' likes and comments, and they cannot reach you
changelog.r0980.16: The Calendar app now loads events through Aetherphone's own service instead of a third-party key
changelog.r0980.17: The Chirper and Aethergram feeds now stay smooth however far you scroll, drawing only the posts on screen
changelog.r0980.18: Photo grids now load small thumbnails and keep full resolution for the viewer alone, so galleries open faster and use far less memory
changelog.r0980.19: The phone now keeps its graphics memory in check, so a long browsing session no longer builds up and slows the game down
changelog.r0980.20: The connection now holds steady even with thousands of players online at once, and calls and live updates recover on their own after a network hiccup
changelog.r0980.21: The phone is sturdier now: a glitch inside one app can no longer bring the whole phone down with it
changelog.r0980.22: Aethernet now answers noticeably faster across feeds, profiles, chats, and reactions, with its busiest lookups rebuilt and freshly indexed
changelog.r0980.23: Fixed a tap on a chat menu also pressing the message bubble behind it
changelog.r0980.24: Fixed the photo picker in chat showing old photos: it now refreshes every time you open it
changelog.r0980.25: Fixed Collections showing the wrong progress on its tiles
changelog.r0980.26: Fixed the clock reading the wrong time when your custom clock format included the AM or PM marker
changelog.r0980.27: Fixed the phone forgetting your Lock Position setting whenever you minimized or maximized it
changelog.r0980.28: Fixed the phone being willing to open any kind of link: it now opens only ordinary web links
changelog.r0980.29: Fixed some conversations showing no last-message preview in your chat list
changelog.r0980.30: Fixed loading older messages in a conversation sometimes skipping or repeating one
changelog.r0980.31: Aethernet now stands up to abuse and sudden spikes in traffic: rate limits, a cap on live connections, and health checks keep it responsive even when everyone is online at once
changelog.r0980.32: Everything you post and send is now backed up off-site automatically, so your data stays safe even if something goes wrong
changelog.r0980.33: Settings now has a Delete account button in the Account section that removes your account and erases everything held for it on Aethernet
changelog.r0970.0: Velvet now has stories: share a photo your connections can watch for 24 hours before it disappears on its own
changelog.r0970.1: You can now tap the seen count on your own story to see everyone who watched it, and when
changelog.r0970.2: Tapping a profile photo in Chirper, Aethergram, Velvet, or Message now opens it enlarged
changelog.r0970.3: The story tray now scrolls away with the feed instead of staying pinned above the posts
changelog.r0970.4: Aethergram's bottom tabs now light up and name themselves as you point at them
changelog.r0970.5: Notification rows now highlight as you point at them in Chirper, Aethergram, and Velvet
changelog.r0970.6: Photo captions on Aethergram, Velvet, and stories now go through moderation alongside the photo itself
changelog.r0970.7: A story photo that is still in review is now held back in the story viewer, the way it already was everywhere else
changelog.r0970.8: Aetherphone is now about a third smaller to download and install: the wallpapers it ships with are packed far more efficiently at the same resolution
changelog.r0970.9: Encrypted chats now set up on computers that run the game through Wine or Proton, where creating the security key used to fail
changelog.r0970.10: A PC that cannot support encrypted chats now says so in the chat encryption sheet, instead of showing Setting up encryption forever
changelog.r0970.11: Fixed composing a story framing your photo as a square when it publishes tall
changelog.r0970.12: Fixed sharing a story showing no progress, leaving the Share button looking untouched for the whole upload
changelog.r0970.13: Fixed being offered a new story tile beside the ring of the story you had already posted
changelog.r0970.14: Fixed a story's caption and its seen count landing on top of each other
changelog.r0970.15: Fixed leaving an app in the middle of a story leaving that story hanging over the app when you came back
changelog.r0970.16: Fixed the story delete confirmation saying it couldn't delete the post
changelog.r0970.17: A story that has expired is now treated as gone everywhere, including its viewer list
changelog.r0970.18: Fixed Aetherphone closing the game on startup for players whose Windows country or regional format is set to Russia or Belarus
changelog.r0970.19: Fixed some labels, such as the Ringtone row in Settings and the Control Center tiles, staying in the previous language after you changed language
changelog.r0970.20: Fixed the details under a Velvet profile's name landing on top of each other when the person is looking for several things at once
changelog.r0970.21: Turkish uppercase labels are now spelled correctly throughout the phone: headings like UYARILAR no longer come out with a lowercase ı in the middle
changelog.r0970.22: You can now mention people with @ in a chirp, a caption, or a comment across Chirper, Aethergram, and Velvet: the handle becomes a link that opens their profile
changelog.r0970.23: Typing @ while composing now suggests people to pick from, so you no longer have to remember a handle exactly
changelog.r0970.24: Being mentioned now reaches you as a notification that opens the post it came from
changelog.r0970.25: You can now tag people in your Aethergram photos: turn on Tag people while composing, tap the photo, and choose who it is
changelog.r0970.26: A photo carrying tags now shows a small person chip: tap it to reveal the names, and tap a name to open that profile
changelog.r0970.27: Aethergram profiles now have a Tagged tab, holding the photos you have been tagged in
changelog.r0970.28: Settings now has a Tags and mentions screen, where you choose who can mention you in posts and comments, and who can tag you in photos
changelog.r0970.29: You can now hold tags for review before they appear: turn on Manually approve tags, and nothing reaches your Tagged tab until you approve it
changelog.r0970.30: Fixed the reason a call was declined or unavailable, the Wallet section headers, and the Calculator error staying in English whatever language your phone was set to
changelog.r0970.31: Fixed the edited marker on a message reading backwards in Turkish, Japanese, and German, where the time has to come first
changelog.r0970.32: Fixed a post's detail view still showing In review after the review had finished, and hiding the comments other people had left
changelog.r0970.33: Fixed speckles appearing along the edges of small rounded corners
changelog.r0970.34: The phone now tells you when a newer Aetherphone is out: an update button appears beneath it, and clicking it takes you straight to Dalamud's plugin installer
changelog.r0970.35: Fixed the phone forgetting where you last left it minimized, so minimizing it again returns it to that spot instead of the full phone's corner
changelog.r0970.36: Fixed the phone forgetting where you had placed it, full size and minimized, whenever the plugin was turned off and on again or the game restarted
changelog.r0970.37: Velvet photos are now for your connections only: the feed no longer shows posts from people you have not connected with
changelog.r0970.38: Choosing who can see a Velvet post is gone, because every post now goes to your connections and no further
changelog.r0970.41: You can now disconnect from someone in Velvet without blocking them, which ends the connection for both of you
changelog.r0970.42: Disconnecting in Velvet takes the chat out of both inboxes, and connecting again later brings the conversation back
changelog.r0970.39: Fixed importing a photo from your PC doing nothing visible when composing an Aethergram or Velvet post: it now lands in the photo grid, selected and numbered
changelog.r0970.40: Fixed Aethergram saying nothing when you tried to add a ninth photo to a post, instead of telling you eight is the limit
changelog.r0960.0: Velvet has been rebuilt from the ground up, with an after-dark look and every screen redrawn around Discover
changelog.r0960.1: Velvet's Discover filters now live behind a filter button, leaving the whole screen to the people you are browsing
changelog.r0960.2: Velvet's role and tag pickers are now sorted into categories that match how roleplay communities actually describe themselves
changelog.r0960.3: Setting up Velvet is now a guided flow that walks you through your identity, what you are looking for, and your profile
changelog.r0960.4: Velvet now has a guided tour that shows you around the first time you open it
changelog.r0960.5: Velvet now speaks every language Aetherphone supports, instead of always showing English
changelog.r0960.6: You can now send an intro message with a Velvet connection request, and choose who is allowed to message you
changelog.r0960.7: Japanese, Chinese, Russian, and Korean text now renders everywhere in the phone instead of turning into question marks, whatever language your phone is set to
changelog.r0960.8: New messages and notifications now reach you the moment they are sent, instead of waiting for the next refresh
changelog.r0960.9: You can now stay signed in on several computers at once: a second install no longer knocks the first offline, and calls ring properly again
changelog.r0960.10: Picking up a call on one device now stops the ringing on the others
changelog.r0960.11: The phone now goes quiet while it is closed or minimized, cutting its background network use to a fraction
changelog.r0960.12: Photos and other media now load faster and are reused from cache instead of being downloaded again every time
changelog.r0960.13: KupoAI now answers everyday questions far more reliably instead of coming up empty when your wording does not match the wiki
changelog.r0960.14: KupoAI now reads wiki tables and infoboxes, so unlock requirements, item costs, and step tables make it into its answers
changelog.r0960.15: KupoAI now recognizes the colloquial names people actually use for pages, not just their official titles
changelog.r0960.16: KupoAI replies no longer carry stray bracketed citation numbers
changelog.r0960.17: The phone now opens by itself when you log in; you can turn this off in Settings
changelog.r0960.18: Dragging the minimized phone no longer drags the full phone with it: each one remembers its own place on screen
changelog.r0960.19: Fixed comments overlapping each other in a Chirper post thread when they had likes
changelog.r0960.20: The Aetherphone website is now available in all eight languages and follows your browser's language automatically
changelog.r0960.21: Plugin developers can now propose their plugin as a phone app through the new App integration request form on GitHub
changelog.r0960.22: Aethergram and Velvet posts can now hold up to 8 photos instead of just one
changelog.r0960.23: Posts with several photos now show dot indicators and arrows, so you can swipe through them straight from the feed
changelog.r0960.24: Composing a multi-photo post now walks you through framing each photo in turn before you write the caption
changelog.r0960.25: Aethergram now has stories: share a photo that everyone can watch for 24 hours before it disappears on its own
changelog.r0960.26: The Aethergram feed now opens with a story tray, where a bright ring marks anyone whose story you have not watched yet
changelog.r0960.27: Fixed photo grids and chat image bubbles shaking every frame in the gallery, the post composers, the wallpaper picker, and message threads
changelog.r0960.28: Fixed the compose button also clicking the post sitting behind it in Chirper, Velvet, and Message
changelog.r0960.29: Fixed Chirper reacting to the post underneath when you clicked an open menu on top of it
changelog.r0950.0: Aetherphone now has its own website at www.aetherphone.net, where you can explore the phone and all of its apps
changelog.r0950.1: Velvet chats now let you react to messages with an emoji, and clicking a reaction count shows who reacted
changelog.r0950.2: You can now reply to a Velvet message, with the original quoted inside your bubble
changelog.r0950.3: You can now edit or delete a Velvet message you already sent
changelog.r0950.4: You can now record and send voice notes in Velvet
changelog.r0950.5: You can now search for radio stations by name in Music
changelog.r0950.6: Radio browsing in Music now loads more stations as you keep scrolling and offers more genres to explore

changelog.r0950.8: Message and Velvet now load older messages when you scroll to the top of a conversation
changelog.r0950.9: Encrypted chats look cleaner now that the redundant lock icon no longer appears on every message bubble
changelog.r0940.0: You can now like comments in Chirper, Aethergram, and Velvet, and you get notified when someone likes yours
changelog.r0940.1: Aetherphone now connects through api.aetherphone.net, its own permanent address; the switch happens automatically and needs nothing from you
changelog.r0940.2: Server traffic now runs behind additional protection against outages and abuse, for a more reliable connection
changelog.r0931.0: Fixed encrypted chats being stuck on Setting up encryption: the key exchange now completes, and Message and Velvet conversations lock end-to-end as intended
changelog.r0931.1: Encryption setup now retries on its own after a connection hiccup instead of staying stuck until you relog
changelog.r0931.2: An open chat now notices when your contact becomes ready for encryption and locks the conversation without you having to reopen it
changelog.r0930.0: You can now reply to any message in Message: the quoted original shows inside your bubble, and clicking it jumps back to that message
changelog.r0930.1: React to messages with a quick emoji strip; reaction counts appear under the bubble, and clicking a count shows who reacted
changelog.r0930.2: You can now edit a text you already sent, and edited messages show a small marker next to the time
changelog.r0930.3: Delete a message for everyone in the chat; it is replaced by a quiet placeholder
changelog.r0930.4: Forward a message to another chat: it arrives with a Forwarded label and you land in that conversation right away
changelog.r0930.5: Record voice notes with the mic button and send them as playable bubbles with progress and duration
changelog.r0930.6: Search inside a conversation from the chat header and jump between matches
changelog.r0930.7: Star messages you want to keep and find them all in the new Starred screen
changelog.r0930.8: Mute a busy chat from the list: its banners stop and it no longer counts toward the app badge
changelog.r0930.9: Chats now show when the other person is online or when they were last seen
changelog.r0930.10: Text you typed but never sent is kept as a draft and previewed in the chat list
changelog.r0930.11: Message info on your own messages shows when they were sent and read, member by member in groups
changelog.r0930.12: The encryption banner is now a lock in the chat header: click it to see a security code you can compare with your contact
changelog.r0930.13: New privacy toggles in Settings let you turn off read receipts and hide when you were last online
changelog.r0930.14: Rebuilt Music as a Spotify-style experience with a dark look, a personalized home screen, a dedicated search screen, and radio categories
changelog.r0930.15: Playing a song no longer switches screens: a mini player slides in at the bottom instead
changelog.r0930.16: Now Playing opens as a full-screen sheet with album art, drag-to-seek, and a volume slider
changelog.r0930.17: You can now pause and resume playback, including radio stations, from Music, the mini player, or the Dynamic Island
changelog.r0930.18: Folders on the Home screen now show a badge with the total unread count of the apps inside
changelog.r0930.19: Added page-flip buttons at the left and right edges of the Home screen as an alternative to swiping
changelog.r0930.20: Fresh installs now start with a curated two-page Home layout and a stocked dock
changelog.r0930.21: Repacked Control Center into a tidy grid with no empty cells; existing layouts move over automatically
changelog.r0930.22: The media control in Control Center is now a large square tile with artwork, title, and playback buttons
changelog.r0930.23: Darkened the backdrop behind Control Center so Home icons no longer show through the tiles
changelog.r0930.24: Tapping the Dynamic Island now opens the app it is showing, even while the island is expanded
changelog.r0930.25: A burst of messages from one conversation now updates a single banner instead of playing one banner per message
changelog.r0930.26: Fixed new-message alerts never appearing while the phone was closed or minimized with Message left open
changelog.r0930.27: Fixed long tooltips spilling past the window edge; they now wrap and stay inside
changelog.r0920.0: Added KupoAI, a new app that answers your questions about Final Fantasy XIV straight from the wiki, complete with sources to read more
changelog.r0920.1: Combined Friends, Phone, and your direct messages into a single app called ChocoChat, so your chats, contacts, and calls all live in one place
changelog.r0920.2: The Calls tab now keeps a full call history like a real phone, and badges any calls you missed
changelog.r0920.3: A brief connection drop no longer ends your call: it quietly reconnects on its own within a short grace period
changelog.r0920.4: You can now reopen an ongoing call from the Dynamic Island at the top of the screen
changelog.r0920.5: You can browse your chats and contacts during a call, and switch to another call without hanging up first
changelog.r0920.6: Merged the Chat, Contacts, and Find People apps into one in-game messaging app and renamed it Linkpearl, with a new pearl icon
changelog.r0920.7: Added a guided setup after the welcome screen that walks you through signing in, setting up your profile and photo, and choosing your analytics preference
changelog.r0920.8: Reporting now happens through one consistent popup everywhere, where you pick a category and add details, instead of a different form in each app
changelog.r0920.9: The welcome tour now points right at the real buttons and widgets on screen as it guides you around the phone
changelog.r0920.10: Links in your messages are now underlined and open in your browser when you click them
changelog.r0920.11: New automatic moderation reviews everything posted to the social apps and flags or removes anything inappropriate to keep the feeds safe
changelog.r0910.0: Your one-to-one and group chats in Messages, and your Velvet messages, are now end-to-end encrypted, so only you and the people you're talking to can read them. Not even the server can
changelog.r0910.1: Encryption is automatic: your key is created quietly the first time you sign in, with nothing to set up and no passphrase to remember
changelog.r0910.2: On a new computer a fresh key is created automatically, and older messages become readable again once your chat partners come online
changelog.r0910.3: Added an Encrypted Chats page in Settings to check your encryption status or reset your key
changelog.r0910.4: Encrypted messages show a small lock, and a banner lets you know when a conversation is end-to-end encrypted
changelog.r0910.5: You can now report a message: right-click it and choose Report. The message and a few before it are shared with the moderators, decrypted, so they can review it
changelog.r0910.6: Right-clicking a message now opens a quick menu to report it or copy its text
changelog.r0900.0: Added Friends, a new app to add people by their phone number and share your own number in-game
changelog.r0900.1: Added Messages, a new app for private one-to-one and group chats with your friends
changelog.r0900.2: Calling is now limited to friends who have added each other, so only people you both trust can reach you
changelog.r0900.3: You can now request a new phone number in Friends if someone you would rather not hear from has your old one
changelog.r0900.4: Rebuilt the Home screen around a flexible grid of app icons, folders, and resizable widgets
changelog.r0900.5: Added a dock at the bottom of the Home screen for up to four favorite apps
changelog.r0900.6: Added Home screen widgets, including a Skywatcher forecast, Clock, Calendar, a Photos shuffle, and Resets
changelog.r0900.7: Added a gallery to browse widgets and preview their sizes before placing them
changelog.r0900.8: Added a Home edit mode to rearrange icons, resize widgets, disband folders, and drag items to new pages
changelog.r0900.9: Apps now open and close by growing from and shrinking back to their icon
changelog.r0900.10: Swipe up from the home bar to return to the Home screen from any app
changelog.r0900.11: Added a Home grid density option for five, six, or seven rows, plus a layout reset, in Settings
changelog.r0900.12: Skywatcher now shows live animated weather in the app and on its widget
changelog.r0900.13: Redesigned the Venues cards and added a detail page for each venue
changelog.r0900.14: Added an Activity tab to Chirper, Aethergram, and Velvet that gathers your likes, comments, and follows
changelog.r0900.15: Added a quick menu to posts for actions like reporting and deleting
changelog.r0900.16: Velvet now lets you pin conversations to the top of your chats
changelog.r0900.17: Renamed the old Messages app to Chat, since it covers your linkshell and in-game chat
changelog.r0900.18: Added a mute bell to each linkshell in Chat so you can silence a busy channel straight from the list
changelog.r0900.19: Combined calls and now-playing music into one Dynamic Island that splits in two, just like on a real phone
changelog.r0900.20: Notification banners now spring in, pause while you hover them, and can be flicked upward to dismiss
changelog.r0900.21: Control Center is now customizable: rearrange, resize, add, and remove its controls like the Home screen
changelog.r0900.22: The minimized phone now morphs smoothly to and from full size, with expand and close buttons and an unread badge
changelog.r0900.23: Added photo zoom with panning and double-tap across Photos, Aethergram, Velvet, and Chat
changelog.r0900.24: Redesigned the phone's side buttons and frame with a machined graphite metal finish
changelog.r0900.25: Reworked Settings with real icons, an account banner up top, and animated toggles
changelog.r0900.26: Redesigned the welcome tour with an animated illustration, and tours now glide smoothly between steps
changelog.r0900.27: Action buttons across the app now show matching animated tooltips when you hover them
changelog.r0900.28: Smoothed out app open, close, and minimize animations so they feel physical and can be interrupted
changelog.r0900.29: Tidied up the codebase and shared design system for better performance and a more consistent look
changelog.r0900.30: Fixed the phone's corners so every screen and app uses one consistent rounded shape
changelog.r0900.31: Fixed tooltips that could appear behind Control Center tiles
changelog.r0900.32: Fixed 2048 so swiping slides the tiles instead of leaving duplicates behind
changelog.r0870.0: Added Polls, a new app for voting in single-choice polls

changelog.r0870.2: Added tappable follower and following lists on profiles, and a liked-by list on posts
changelog.r0870.10: Refined the comment section in Aethergram
changelog.r0870.3: Velvet now lets you cancel connection requests you've sent, review them in a compact Sent section, and disconnect from people you're connected with

changelog.r0870.6: Changed the default wallpaper to Dusk
changelog.r0870.7: Fixed the Camera screen corners so they're rounded to match the rest of the phone
changelog.r0870.8: Fixed the phone-scrolling emote continuing to play while the phone is minimized
changelog.r0870.9: Fixed a crash in the Music app on Linux

changelog.r0850.3: Added Feedback so you can send thoughts and bug reports straight to the developers
