games.onlineMiniGolfAimHint: Drag back from the ball and let go to putt
games.searchEmptyHint: Try another name, or clear the search.
gamesHub.recordsEmptyHint: Finish a game and your best result lands here.
gamesHub.codeHint: Share this code so friends can join.
gamesHub.togetherHint: Host a room for friends, or join one with a code.
gamesHub.tourTogetherBody: Host a room for Uno, Chess, Mini Golf and more, or join a friend's room with a code.
gamesHub.tourLibraryBody: Search by name, filter by genre, or sort by newest or recently played.
gamesHub.tourProfileBody: Your daily streak, ranks and personal bests live here. Tap to have a look.
gamesHub.whatsNewGames: 26 new games, from Mahjong Solitaire to Mini Golf
gamesHub.whatsNewLeaderboards: Leaderboards you can choose to join, worldwide or among friends
gamesHub.whatsNewRooms: Play Moogle War, Broadside, Lucky Draw and Mini Golf online with friends
gamesHub.whatsNewRedesign: A new look with Home, Together, Library and Profile tabs
leaderboard.emptyHint: Be the first to set one.
leaderboard.signInHint: Sign in to see where you stand and send your bests to the board.
leaderboard.consentBody: Your best score in each game can go on the global and friends leaderboards.
leaderboard.consentShown: Other players see your display name, @handle, avatar and badges next to your scores.
leaderboard.consentOff: If you stay off, your scores stay on this phone.
leaderboard.consentSettings: You can change this any time in Settings > Privacy.
leaderboard.unavailableHint: Your best scores stay on this phone until they open.
leaderboard.offHint: When this is off, your scores stay on this phone.
coil.title: Coil
coil.howTo: Aim with the mouse and click to fire. Right-click or Space swaps marbles.
coil.hook: Fire marbles into the chain and match three or more to clear it before it reaches the vortex.
updraft.title: Updraft
updraft.hook: Steer the bird between the thermals and ride the updrafts as high as you can.
swoop.title: Swoop
swoop.hook: Hold to dive down the slopes and let go to soar, chasing the islands before nightfall.
games.pinball.title: Pinball
games.pinball.hook: Pull the plunger with Space or a drag and flip with A and D or a tap on each side. Chain ramps, orbits and the saucer into combos to raise the playfield multiplier and charge Fever.
games.delve.title: Delve
games.delve.hook: Dig through the cave, grab enough gems to open the exit and get out before time runs out. Falling boulders crush anything below, you included.
games.crates.title: Crates
games.crates.hook: Push every crate onto a glowing target. Crates only move when pushed, so think before you shove.
games.moogleclicker.title: Kupo Clicker
games.moogleclicker.hook: Tap the moogle for kupo, hire a workshop that keeps earning while you play, and close the ledger for stamps.
games.moogleclicker.effectTapShare: Taps add {0}% of kupo per second
games.moogleclicker.upgradesHint: Upgrades appear as your workshop grows
games.moogleclicker.ledgerNext: Next stamp at {0} kupo all time
games.moogleclicker.ledgerExplain: Each stamp adds {0}% kupo forever. Closing the ledger resets kupo, buildings and upgrades.
games.moogleclicker.confirmBody: You keep every stamp and add {0} more. Kupo, buildings and upgrades start over.
games.claim.title: Claim
games.claim.hook: Cut lines into the field to claim 75% of it; slow lines score double, but never let the boss touch a line you are drawing.
games.lander.title: Lander
games.lander.hook: Tilt and fire the engine to set down gently on a lit pad; the narrow pads pay the most, and the fuel runs out.
games.broadside.title: Broadside
games.broadside.hook: Hide five airships on your grid, then trade cannon fire across the clouds until one fleet is gone.
games.broadside.placeHint: Drag ships onto the grid. Tap a ship to turn it.
games.luckydraw.title: Lucky Draw
games.luckydraw.hook: Draw cards to build your score, stop before a duplicate busts you, and race to 200.
games.luckydraw.pickFlipThree: Tap a player to flip three
games.luckydraw.pickChance: Tap a player to give your Second Chance
games.pegfall.title: Pegfall
games.pegfall.hook: Aim from the top and bounce the ball through the pegs. Light every orange peg to clear the level, and catch the ball in the moving bucket for a free one.
games.fling.title: Fling
games.fling.hook: Drag the sling back and let go to launch birds at the goblin forts. Pop every goblin, and tap mid-flight to split a blue bird into three.
games.siege.title: Garden Siege
games.siege.hook: Drag defenders onto the garden, tap the falling sunlight, and stop the mandragoras before they reach your flowers.
games.siege.shovelHint: Shovel: tap a defender to dig it up
games.siege.tipPlant: Drag a card onto the garden, or tap a card and then a square.
games.siege.tipSprout: Sprouts shoot seeds straight up their column.
games.siege.tipSunbloom: Sunblooms grow extra sunlight. Tap it to collect it.
games.siege.tipThornwall: Thornwalls block a column and take ages to chew through.
games.siege.tipFrostbud: Frostbud seeds chill mandragoras and slow them down.
games.siege.tipBombcap: Bombcaps burst a moment after planting and hit the 3 x 3 around them.
games.siege.tipWalker: Mandragoras march down the columns. Stop them before they reach your flowers.
games.siege.tipArmoured: Armoured mandragoras wear a pot that falls off at half health.
games.siege.tipFlyer: Flyers glide over Thornwalls, so keep shooters in their column.
games.siege.tipDigger: Diggers tunnel under your first defender and pop up behind it.
games.siege.tipBoss: The King Mandragora is huge, slow, and calls for help.
games.siege.tipEndless: Endless waves that keep growing. How long can your garden hold?
games.crater.title: Moogle War
games.crater.hook: Take turns lobbing shells and be the last moogle team standing.
games.crater.grenadeHint: Fuse {0}s, press 1 to 5 to change it
games.crater.teleportHint: Tap a spot to teleport there
games.crater.shieldHint: Fire to raise a shield that absorbs one hit
games.crater.controlsHint: A and D walk, drag or arrows aim, hold Space or the button to fire
games.fuse.title: Fuse
games.fuse.hook: Drop bombs to blast the crates, grab their power-ups and be the last moogle standing; win two rounds to take the match.
games.minigolf.title: Mini Golf
games.minigolf.hook: Drag back from the ball to aim, let go to putt, and sink every hole in as few strokes as you can.
games.snip.title: Snip
games.snip.hook: Swipe across the ropes to drop the crystal into the moogle's mouth, and catch all three stars on the way.
games.tempo.title: Tempo
games.tempo.hook: Tap to jump to the beat over spikes and gaps, and hold on a jump pad to soar further. Three hidden coins wait on every level.
games.tempo.practiceHint: Tap the flag to drop a checkpoint, the cross to lift the last one
games.herd.title: Herd
games.herd.hook: Pick a skill, then tap a moogle to dig, build, block or bash a way from the door to the hut. Save enough of them to clear the level.
games.herd.blockHint: Stands firm and turns the others around
games.herd.digHint: Digs straight down through the ground
games.herd.bridgeHint: Lays a staircase of twelve steps
games.herd.climbHint: Climbs every wall it meets from now on
games.herd.floatHint: Opens a pom-pom canopy on long falls
games.herd.paused: Paused: tap moogles to give skills
games.herd.nukeArmed: Tap again to pop them all
games.slice.title: Slice
games.slice.hook: Swipe to slice everything thrown into the air, and never touch a bomb.
games.spiral.title: Spiral
games.spiral.hook: Drag to turn the tower and drop the ball through the gaps, but never land on red.
games.mahjong.title: Mahjong Solitaire
games.mahjong.hook: Match pairs of free tiles, ones with nothing on top and an open left or right side, until the table is clear.
games.mahjong.undoToContinue: Undo a move to keep going
games.gloop.title: Gloop
games.gloop.hook: Drop pairs of blobs, link four or more of a color to pop them, and set off chains for big points.
games.drift.title: Drift
games.drift.hook: Rotate, thrust and blast the drifting rocks to pieces. Every edge wraps around, and saucers hunt you from wave 3.
games.crawler.title: Crawler
games.crawler.hook: Slide along the bottom and shoot the crawler as it winds down the mushroom field; every segment you hit splits it and sprouts a mushroom.
games.trails.title: Trails
games.trails.hook: Turn left or right and never touch a trail. Outlast the bots to take the round; first to three wins the match.
games.thrust.title: Thrust
games.thrust.hook: Hold to fly up and let go to drop, dodging zappers and missiles as you grab the coins.
games.trailblaze.title: Choco Surfer
games.trailblaze.hook: Swipe or use the arrow keys to switch lanes, jump the pits and slide under the beams as your chocobo races on.
minimized.title: Minimized phone
minimized.liveHint: Music and calls take over the card at the bottom while they play. Notifications drop in as a banner over the clock.
minimized.pagesHint: Each page you turn on shows in the card at the bottom of the mini phone. Scroll the wheel over the card to flip between them.
minimized.shapeHint: Choose what the phone collapses into. The minimap draws the zone map around you, so it can sit where the game minimap does.
minimized.wallpaperHint: Paints your home wallpaper behind the mini phone, dimmed so the clock stays readable.
minimized.minimapHint: The map faces north and shows your heading, the zone name and your coordinates. Tap it to open the phone.
minimized.minimapZoomHint: Scroll the wheel over the map to zoom, or use the plus and minus buttons that fade in when you hover it.
minimized.resizeHint: Drag its bottom right corner to make the minimized phone bigger or smaller.
plugin.commandHelp: Type {0} help to list every command.
plugin.openUsage: Type {0} open followed by an app name.
plugin.appNotInstalled: Install {0} from the App Store first.
plugin.musicUsage: Type {0} music followed by play, pause, next, or prev.
plugin.tellUsage: Target a player, or type {0} tell followed by their name and world.
plugin.callUsage: Type {0} call followed by a contact name.
plugin.unknownCommand: Unknown command {0}. Type {1} help to see every command.
plugin.sideButtonHint: Tap to minimize · Hold to turn off
plugin.updateChipHint: A newer Aetherphone is ready. Click to open Dalamud's plugin installer.
plugin.serverBarClickHint: Click to open or close the phone
feedback.hubIntro: Tell the developer what's broken, what you'd love to see, or what made your day.
feedback.placeholderBug: What did you do, what did you expect, and what happened instead?
feedback.placeholderIdea: What problem would it solve for you? How do you picture it working?
feedback.placeholderPraise: Tell us what made your day. It helps us know what to keep.
feedback.thanksBug: We'll look into it. Reports with clear steps get fixed fastest.
feedback.thanksIdea: Your idea is in. Some of the best features started as a message like this.
feedback.thanksPraise: That made our day. Thank you for taking the time.
feedback.thanksOther: Your message is on its way to the developer.
feedback.historyEmptyHint: Feedback you send shows up here, so you can see when it's been handled.
feedback.privacyNote: The developer reads everything you send. Please leave out passwords and private details.
feedback.signInHint: Feedback is tied to your Aethernet account, so you can follow what happens to it.
feedback.screenshotHint: A screenshot makes a bug much easier to fix.
feedback.sendFailed: Couldn't send. Your draft is saved.
feedback.discardConfirm: Discard this draft? Your text and screenshots will be removed.
feedback.noPhotosHint: Take one with Camera, or import an image from your PC.
feedback.statusReceivedHint: The developer reads every message. You'll get a notification when something changes.
feedback.statusResolvedHint: Marked as resolved. Thanks for helping make Aetherphone better.
feedback.statusClosedHint: Closed without changes. Not every idea fits, but every one is read.
feedback.statusReviewHint: The developer is looking into this right now.
feedback.statusPlannedHint: Good news: this is on the list. You'll get a notification when it's done.
feedback.reasonDuplicateHint: Someone reported this already, so it's being followed there. Thanks for adding your voice.
feedback.reasonWontDoHint: This was given real thought, but it isn't planned for now. Thank you for sharing it.
feedback.reasonCantReproduceHint: The developer couldn't make this happen. If you see it again, send a new report with the steps and a screenshot.
feedback.reasonNotABugHint: This turned out to be working as intended. Thanks for pointing it out all the same.
feedback.updateReply: The developer replied to your feedback
feedback.updateBugInReview: Your bug report is in review
feedback.updateBugPlanned: A fix for your bug report is planned
polls.signInRequired: Sign in to Aethernet in Settings to see polls
polls.voteFailed: Your vote wasn't saved. Try again.
polls.emptyOpenHint: New community polls land here, and the app badge tells you when one needs your vote.
polls.refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh. Pull down to try again.
announcements.signInRequired: Sign in to Aethernet in Settings to read announcements
announcements.emptyHint: News from the Aetherphone team lands here.
announcements.refreshFailed: Couldn't refresh. Showing what you already have.
calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.deleteConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete this event?
calendar.deleteGroupConfirmMessage: Delete this group? Its events stay in the calendar without a group.
calendar.addEventHint: Tap to plan something on this day.
calendar.failedToLoadBody: In-game events are unavailable right now. Your own events still work.
calendar.upcomingEmptyBody: Your events and in-game events for the next 30 days show up here.
calendar.eventGoneBody: This event is no longer in your calendar.
calendar.deleteRepeatingMessage: Delete this event? Every repeat of it will be removed.
calendar.groupsHintBody: Make groups like Raids or FC Nights, give each a color, and choose where it shows.
onboarding.allInOneBody: Chat, music, weather, the market board, mini-games and more, all in your pocket.
onboarding.actionTourBody: This Action button turns Do Not Disturb on or off.
onboarding.lockTourBody: This button locks the phone's position on your screen so it stays put while you play.
onboarding.linkpearlIntroBody: Your in-game chat on your phone. Tells arrive here on their own, and you can add tabs for your Free Company, linkshells and party.
onboarding.linkpearlNewChatBody: Tap here to add a tab for a game channel or to send someone a tell.
onboarding.linkpearlChannelBody: Tap a tile to turn that channel into a chat tab and open it.
onboarding.linkpearlReplyBody: Type here to reply. Your message is sent in game, on the channel shown in the chip on the left.
onboarding.linkpearlLayoutBody: Tap to switch this chat between a game-style log and chat bubbles. Tap again anytime to switch back.
onboarding.linkpearlMoreBody: Tap for this chat's options: pin it, mute it, or pop it out into a window that stays open when the phone is closed.
onboarding.chocoChatIntroBody: Chats and voice calls with other Aetherphone players. Save each other's numbers to get started.
onboarding.chocoChatNewChatBody: Tap here to message one of your contacts or start a group chat.
onboarding.chocoChatCallsBody: Tap Calls. Voice calls with your contacts and your call history live here.
onboarding.chocoChatContactsBody: Tap Contacts. You can chat with and call anyone once you have saved each other's numbers.
onboarding.chocoChatNumberBody: Friends add you with this number. Tap the card to copy it, then share it with them.
onboarding.chocoChatAddContactBody: Tap New contact and enter a friend's number. They show as Pending until they save your number too.
onboarding.notificationsAlertsBody: Alerts from all your apps stack up here. Tap a stack to fan it out, tap an alert to open it, or swipe left to dismiss it.
onboarding.notificationsAnywhereBody: Swipe down from the top of the screen, or tap it, to open Control Center. Your notifications are there too.
onboarding.notificationsFocusBody: The moon turns on Do Not Disturb. Banners and sounds pause, and every notification still collects here.
onboarding.skywatcherHoursBody: Each upcoming weather window, with the real minutes until it starts.
onboarding.skywatcherControlBody: Tap Control to choose the time and weather you see.
onboarding.skywatcherZonesBody: Save zones under Zones to see their sky at a glance, then tap one for its full forecast.
onboarding.skywatcherTimeBody: Drag the bar, or tap Dawn, Noon, Dusk or Midnight, to change the time of day around you.
onboarding.skywatcherWeatherBody: Tap any weather this zone can have. Only you see it, and Natural brings the real sky back.
onboarding.marketIntroBody: Live market board prices from Universalis for any item, on your world, data center or region.
onboarding.marketFindBody: Tap the search field and type a few letters of any item name.
onboarding.marketOpenBody: Tap a result to see its current listings and recent sales.
onboarding.marketCheapestBody: The lowest price on the board right now. When the item comes in both qualities, switch NQ and HQ here.
onboarding.marketCompareBody: Your world, its data center, then the whole region. Tap one to compare prices.
onboarding.marketAlertBody: Set a price and get a notification when this item drops below it or rises above it.
onboarding.mapsExpandBody: Tap an expansion to list its regions and every aetheryte in them.
onboarding.mapsMapBody: Your zone's map follows you, and the arrow shows the way you face. Drag to look around and scroll to zoom.
onboarding.mapsOpenBody: Tap an aetheryte to see it on a map, with its teleport and favorite actions.
onboarding.mapsTeleportBody: With the Lifestream plugin, Teleport takes you there. Without it, the button copies the command for chat.
onboarding.mapsFavoriteBody: Tap Favorite to keep this place in the row at the top of the sheet.
onboarding.huntsFilterBody: Narrow the marks by data center, world, rank, status or expansion.
onboarding.huntsGuidesBody: New to hunts? This tab explains ranks, window statuses and how spawns work.
onboarding.huntsOpenBody: Tap a mark to see its spawn map and what makes it appear.
onboarding.huntsMapBody: Dots show where this mark can spawn. Tap an aetheryte icon on the map to travel there.
onboarding.fishingRouteBody: Indigo and Ruby boats leave at the same times. Tap the other route to see its voyages.
onboarding.fishingLaterBody: Later voyages, two hours apart, each with its blue fish and local departure time.
onboarding.venuesScopeBody: This pill sets where venues come from: your world, data center or region, a place you pick, or everywhere.
onboarding.venuesOpenNowBody: Every venue open right now. The number on this tab tells you how many.
onboarding.venuesCategoryBody: Tap a category to see every venue of that kind.
onboarding.venuesOpenBody: Tap a venue to open its page: what it's about, when it opens next and where to find it.
onboarding.venuesGoBody: Asks you to confirm, then travels you to the venue with the Lifestream plugin.
onboarding.venuesSaveBody: Tap the star to keep this venue in your Favorites tab.
onboarding.stratsOpenBody: Tap a fight to open its raid cheatsheet.
onboarding.stratsStrategyBody: Pick the strat your party runs. Region tags show where it's common, and your pick is saved for this fight.
onboarding.stratsSpotBody: Tap the party spot you play. Mechanics then show what that spot does.
onboarding.stratsScrollBody: Scroll down to the first mechanic.
onboarding.stratsMechanicBody: Each card explains one mechanic, in fight order. When it has a Your spot panel, that shows what you do.
onboarding.musicIntroBody: Play any song, build playlists, tune in to radio from around the world, and listen together with friends.
onboarding.musicFindBody: Tap Search to look up songs, artists and playlists. Paste a YouTube playlist link to import it.
onboarding.musicScopesBody: Pick what to search: songs, playlists, artists, radio stations or your own library.
onboarding.musicJamBody: Start a Jam from Home or Now Playing and share the code, so friends hear the same song in sync.
onboarding.musicRadioTabBody: Radio has world stations from every country, plus community radio with live chat and song requests. Tap to open it.
onboarding.musicLibraryBody: Library keeps your playlists, artists, loved songs and downloads for offline play. Tap to open it.
onboarding.musicPlaylistBody: Open Playlists to make one, reorder its songs, or import a playlist from YouTube.
onboarding.photosLibraryBody: Shots you take with Camera and new game screenshots land in Library. Tap to open it.
onboarding.photosOpenBody: Tap any photo to see it full screen, where you can edit it, favorite it or add it to an album.
onboarding.photosNewAlbumBody: Tap plus to create an album and give it a name.
onboarding.photosTrashBody: Deleted photos wait in Recently Deleted for 30 days, so you can still recover them.
onboarding.photosLevelsBody: This bar changes how your library is grouped. Tap Months to see each month as a card.
onboarding.photosCollectionsBody: Tap Collections to see your albums, the places you took photos, Favorites and Recently Deleted.
onboarding.cameraFrameBody: The viewfinder shows the game behind the phone. Move your camera in game to frame the shot.
onboarding.cameraSquareBody: Square crops to a centered square, Photo keeps the whole view. Tap Square to try it.
onboarding.cameraShootBody: Tap the shutter to save what is inside the frame to Photos.
onboarding.cameraHudBody: Tap this to choose whether shots include the game's interface. When it is off, the HUD hides for a moment as you shoot.
onboarding.cameraRotateBody: Tap to turn the phone sideways for wide shots. Tap again to turn it back.
onboarding.cameraLastShotBody: Your latest shot appears here. Tap it to open Photos.
onboarding.cameraTimerBody: Tap to count down 3 or 10 seconds before the shot, so you have time to pose.
onboarding.aetherStreamIntroBody: Watch videos inside the game, on your phone or on a big screen in the world, alone or with friends.
onboarding.aetherStreamPasteBody: Paste a link from YouTube or another video page to start watching.
onboarding.aetherStreamScreenBody: Tap Screen to place the video on a big screen out in the game world.
onboarding.aetherStreamPartyTabBody: Tap Party to watch with friends.
onboarding.aetherStreamStartBody: In a party, everyone watches the same second of the same video. Friends on any world join with your invite code.
onboarding.aetherStreamLibraryBody: Library holds your Up Next queue, your watch history and your saved playlists. Tap to open it.
onboarding.notesStartBody: Tap plus to open a blank note.
onboarding.notesWriteBody: Type anything here. The first line becomes the note's title in your list.
onboarding.notesSaveBody: Tap back to return to your list. Your note saves when you leave it, and an empty one is discarded.
onboarding.notesTodoBody: Tap Reminders for a checklist of things to do.
onboarding.notesAddReminderBody: On this tab, plus adds a reminder instead of a note.
onboarding.notesNudgeBody: Turn this on to pick a day and time. The phone sends you a notification when it is due.
onboarding.activityRingsBody: Progress fills as you gain experience, Adventure as you clear duties and Fortune as you earn gil. Close all three.
onboarding.activityWeekBody: Each day keeps its own small rings. Tap a day to see it in detail.
onboarding.activityGoalsBody: Tap here to change how much each ring asks of you every day.
onboarding.collectionsOpenBody: Each tile is one collection. Tap Mounts to browse the full list.
onboarding.collectionsShowMissingBody: Tap Missing to list only the mounts you have not unlocked yet.
onboarding.collectionsItemBody: Tap any mount to open its details.
onboarding.inventoryFindBody: Type a name to see where you keep it: bags, armoury, saddlebag and any retainer or FC chest you have opened.
onboarding.inventoryOpenBody: Each row is one place your items live. Tap one to see everything in it.
onboarding.inventoryWealthBody: Gil on you and your retainers, plus what your items would fetch on the market board. Tap for the breakdown.
onboarding.jobsHeroBody: The ring fills as you earn EXP toward your next level.
onboarding.jobsOpenBody: Tap any job to see its EXP and gearsets.
onboarding.jobsEquipBody: Tap a gearset to equip it. Crafters and gatherers switch the same way.
onboarding.jobsSortBody: Tap ··· to put this gearset in one of your own categories.
onboarding.jobsGroupsBody: Tap the folder to create your own categories, like raid sets or crafters.
onboarding.dailiesProgressBody: The ring counts what you have done on this list, with the time left until it resets.
onboarding.dailiesAutoBody: These fill in by themselves as you play, read straight from the game.
onboarding.dailiesTickBody: The game does not report these, so tap one once it is done. Tap it again to undo.
onboarding.dailiesWeeklyBody: Tap Weekly for everything that resets once a week.
onboarding.dailiesAddBody: Tap + to add anything you do every day or week. Ticks are kept separately for each character.
onboarding.housingLotteryBody: The phase your world is in right now and how long it has left.
onboarding.housingDistrictsBody: Open plots in each district, by size. Tap a district to see it on the map.
onboarding.housingMapBody: Tap Map to browse the open plots ward by ward.
onboarding.housingNarrowBody: Filters show only the plot sizes, lottery phases and buyers you care about.
onboarding.housingPlotBody: Each marker is an open plot. Tap one for its price, entries and lottery timer.
onboarding.housingTrackBody: Watch adds the plot to your watchlist. Remind Me notifies you before its phase ends.
onboarding.walletCardBody: Your gil, with what changed today and this week. Tap the card to see its history.
onboarding.walletCapRingBody: Each ring fills toward the cap and turns gold as you get close, so you know when to spend.
onboarding.walletActivityBody: Gains and spends land here with the place they happened, so you can see where your currency went.
onboarding.chirperFeedsBody: For You shows chirps you have not seen yet, ranked for you. Latest puts the newest first. Tap one to switch.
onboarding.chirperJoinBody: Under every chirp: reply, rechirp or quote it, react with an emoji, or copy its text.
onboarding.chirperNavBody: Explore finds people and trending tags, Activity shows replies, reactions, mentions and follows, and Profile holds your chirps.
onboarding.chirperWriteBody: Tap the feather to start a chirp. Nothing goes out until you post it.
onboarding.chirperExtrasBody: Attach photos or a GIF and add emoji. The ring fills as you near the character limit.
onboarding.chirperSendBody: Tap Chirp to share it with everyone. It lights up once there is something to post.
onboarding.aethergramFeedsBody: For You shows posts you have not seen yet, ranked for you. Latest puts the newest first. Tap one to switch.
onboarding.aethergramStoriesBody: Tap a ringed picture to watch someone's story, or the plus on your own picture to share one.
onboarding.aethergramReactBody: Tap the heart to like, the bubble to comment, the plane to send the post to someone, or the bookmark to save it.
onboarding.aethergramNavBody: Search finds people and tags, Messages holds your conversations, and Profile shows your grid.
onboarding.aethergramPostBody: Tap the plus to start a new post. Nothing is shared until you say so.
onboarding.aethergramPickBody: Tap photos from your Photos library to choose one or several, or bring one in with Import from PC.
onboarding.pollsCastBody: Tap an option to vote. Tap another one any time to move your vote.
onboarding.pollsTallyBody: Results stay hidden until you vote. Once you have, Undo vote appears on this line to take it back.
onboarding.announcementsReadBody: The newest post sits on top with the longest preview. Tap it to read it in full.
onboarding.announcementsFullBody: Here is the full post. Links ask before they open in your browser.
onboarding.settingsProfileBody: Your character and Aethernet account. Open it to sign in, edit your profile or add another character.
onboarding.settingsAppearanceBody: Tap Appearance to change the theme, wallpaper, app icons and phone case.
onboarding.settingsThemeBody: Choose how the phone looks here. Accent color, app icons, wallpaper and case are further down this page.
onboarding.settingsBackBody: Tap here to return to the main Settings list.
onboarding.settingsSearchBody: Type here to jump straight to any page, or to a single option inside one.
onboarding.appStoreAppsTabBody: Tap Apps to see everything sorted by what it does.
onboarding.appStoreCategoryBody: Tap a category to list the apps inside it.
onboarding.appStoreDetailBody: Tap an app to open its page, with a preview and a description of what it does.
onboarding.appStoreInstallBody: Get puts the app on your Home Screen. Once it is installed, the button reads Open and launches it.
onboarding.appStoreFindBody: Know what you want? Tap Search and type a name or what the app is for.
onboarding.shortcutsStartBody: Tap + to start a new shortcut.
onboarding.shortcutsStepsBody: Tap Add Action to add commands, waits, plugins and links. They run top to bottom, and the grip on each one drags it into place.
onboarding.shortcutsSaveBody: Give it a name here, then tap the checkmark. It joins your library, ready to run with one tap.
onboarding.shortcutsLeaveBody: Tap back to leave the editor. Nothing is kept until you tap the checkmark.
onboarding.shortcutsPluginsTabBody: Tap Plugins to see every Dalamud plugin you have installed.
onboarding.shortcutsPluginRowBody: Tap a plugin to open it, add it to your Home Screen or turn one of its commands into a shortcut.
onboarding.newsMaintenanceBody: Tap Maintenance to see when the servers go down.
onboarding.newsWindowBody: This card counts down to the next maintenance, or to the end of the one in progress, in your local time. Tap it for the details.
onboarding.newsLatestBody: News refreshes on its own every few minutes. Tap here to fetch the newest posts now.
onboarding.feedbackKindBody: Start by choosing a bug, an idea, praise or something else. Tap one to open the composer.
onboarding.feedbackMessageBody: Tap here and describe a bug, an idea or a question. You have up to 1,000 characters.
onboarding.feedbackScreenshotsBody: Attach up to five images from your gallery or your PC. A screenshot makes a bug much easier to fix.
onboarding.feedbackSubmitBody: Tap Send when you are ready. Your draft is kept if anything goes wrong, and you can send one message a minute.
onboarding.healthGoalsTabBody: Tap Goals to see your targets.
onboarding.healthTodayBody: The glass fills as you drink. Tap the plus to log a drink, or the card for your full log.
onboarding.healthMetricsBody: Your character's steps, weight, distance, swimming and active time. Tap any card for its chart.
onboarding.healthGoalCardBody: The ring fills as you get closer. Tap a goal to change its target or switch it off.
onboarding.gamesDailyBody: A new game takes this card every day. Tap it to play, and come back daily to build your streak.
onboarding.casinoIntroBody: A casino floor played with chips you change from Aether Coin. No real money goes in, and none comes out.
onboarding.coinWalletBody: This is your Aether Coin. You earn it by using the phone, and it is never bought with real money.
onboarding.coinDailyBody: Tap Check in once a day for coin. Every day in a row grows your streak bonus.
onboarding.coinShopTabBody: Tap Shop to see what your coin can buy.
onboarding.coinShelvesBody: Each tile opens a category and shows how many items it holds.
onboarding.clockGameTimeBody: Eorzea time leads the page. The sky follows the bell, and the bar counts down to the next one.
onboarding.clockAlarmsTabBody: Tap Alarms to see the alarms you have set.
onboarding.clockNewAlarmBody: Tap + to set up a new alarm.
onboarding.clockAlarmTimeBody: Spin the hour and minute, then pick the days it repeats on. Leave every day off for a one-time alarm.
onboarding.clockAlarmSaveBody: Tap the check to add the alarm and switch it on.
onboarding.calendarPickDayBody: Dots mark days with events. Tap any day to see what is on.
onboarding.calendarDayEventsBody: In-game events and your own plans for that day line up here. Tap one to see its details.
onboarding.calendarGroupsBody: Sort events into groups, then choose which show in the app or on the home widget, in-game events included.
onboarding.calendarNewEventBody: Tap + to add an event on the day you picked.
onboarding.calendarAlertBody: Choose when to be reminded: at the start time, up to a day before, or not at all.
onboarding.calculatorSumBody: Tap in a sum, then press = for the answer.
onboarding.calculatorReuseBody: Every answer lands on this tape. Tap one to carry it into your next sum.
onboarding.calculatorTypeBody: With the pointer over the phone, your keyboard and numpad work too. Press and hold the answer to copy it or paste a number.
onboarding.timersNextUpBody: The top card shows what finishes soonest, or what is ready to collect right now.
onboarding.timersCharactersBody: Retainers are grouped per character and stay here after you log out, stamped with when they were last seen.
onboarding.timersBellBody: Tap a bell and the phone notifies you the moment that timer finishes.
onboarding.velvetCardsBody: Each card is someone open to connecting, best fits first. Tap a card for their profile, or the heart to write them an intro.
onboarding.velvetFiltersBody: Filters decide who shows up in Discover. Tap Filters to open them.
onboarding.velvetFacetBody: Each section holds one kind of filter. Tap this one to see its options.
onboarding.velvetOptionBody: Tick a row to see only those people. Cross it out to hide them from Discover and Feed. Leave it alone to see everyone.
onboarding.velvetResultsBody: Your picks apply as you make them. Tap Show results to go back to Discover.
onboarding.velvetSearchBody: Tap Search to look someone up by name, or type a tag to find the posts that carry it.
onboarding.velvetFeedBody: Feed is where people share photos and posts. Tap Feed to take a look.
onboarding.velvetMeBody: Me holds your profile and your posts. Tap Me to open it.
onboarding.musterScopeBody: Show musters from your data center, your region, or everywhere. Tap one to switch.
onboarding.musterActivityBody: Tap an activity to see only those musters. Pick several to combine them, or All to see everything.
onboarding.musterCardBody: Each card shows the host, the activity and when it starts. Tap one to see where it is and say you're going.
onboarding.musterPlansBody: Plans keeps the musters you join and the one you host, with a countdown and your status.
onboarding.musterStartBody: Tap + to pick the activity, the spot and the time. You can host one muster at a time.
onboarding.yellowPagesPostBody: Tap New ad to list a place, a service or a group. Ads run for 7 days, and you can renew them.
onboarding.yellowPagesInboxBody: Conversations about ads land in Inbox, for your own ads and for the ones you asked about.
onboarding.yellowPagesScopeBody: This shows where ads come from. Tap it to pick a region, a data center, or everywhere.
onboarding.yellowPagesBrowseBody: Go somewhere, hire someone, join something, or see what people are looking for. Tap a tile to open it.
onboarding.yellowPagesChipsBody: Tap a category to see only those ads. Pick several to combine them, or All to clear.
onboarding.yellowPagesAdBody: Tap an ad to read the details. From there, Message the poster starts a conversation with them.
onboarding.skywatcherCurrentBody: This is the zone you're standing in and its live weather, refreshed as you travel.
onboarding.findPeopleSearchBody: Type a character's name here. The world field is set to your data center, but you can point it anywhere.
onboarding.findPeopleKindBody: Flip this to look up Free Companies instead, with crests, slogans and full member rosters.
onboarding.fishingHeroBody: This card is your next boarding window, with the route, its time of day and a countdown to departure.
onboarding.fishingBlueBody: The rare blue fish catchable on this route, each with the bait that tempts it.
onboarding.fishingTimedBody: Big fish and other catches that only bite at certain hours or in certain weather live here. Tap to see what is biting.
onboarding.fishingFishBody: Each row shows when the fish is next up. Open it for bait, weather, the map and a bell that alerts you before the window opens.
onboarding.storeTourBody: The phone starts with a handful of apps. The App Store has the rest, and you decide which ones live on your Home Screen.
onboarding.widgetCustomizeBody: Widgets like this one update on their own. Press and hold anywhere on the Home Screen to rearrange icons, resize widgets and add new ones.
onboarding.statusTourBody: The bars show your ping to the data center you're playing on, and the battery is your computer's real charge.
onboarding.finaleBody: Every app shows you around the first time you open it. Replay this tour anytime from Settings, under Tips & Tutorials.
onboarding.basicsBody: Your phone is ready. Let's try a few quick moves together so you feel right at home.
onboarding.openAppBody: Every icon is an app. Tap Market to open it.
onboarding.homeBarBody: Swipe up on this bar, or tap it, to return to the Home Screen. Press and hold it to switch between open apps.
onboarding.controlCenterCardBody: Tap the top of the screen anytime to open Control Center for Do Not Disturb, music, brightness, volume and your notifications.
onboarding.roomBody: Tap this side button to tuck the phone into a mini phone, then tap the mini phone to bring it back.
setup.welcomeBody: Your very own smartphone, right here in Eorzea. A few quick steps and it's ready to go.
setup.appearanceBody: Pick a light or dark look for your phone. Dynamic follows Eorzean time, so the phone turns dark after sunset.
setup.accountBody: One account unlocks every social app: Chirper, Aethergram, ChocoChat and more. Sign in with your character, no password needed.
setup.signedInBody: Signed in as {0}. Next, make your profile yours.
setup.idBody: Your Aethernet ID is how other players see you across Chirper, Aethergram and ChocoChat. Tap the circle to add a photo.
setup.handleRules: 3 to 15 characters: lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
setup.handleTaken: That handle isn't available. Try another one.
setup.featureMessageBody: Chats, calls and contacts with players everywhere.
setup.featureSocialBody: Post on Chirper and Aethergram with one account.
setup.featureToolsBody: Market board, weather, maps, timers and news.
setup.featurePlayBody: Music, radio and a shelf of mini-games.
setup.readyBody: You're all set. Enjoy your Aetherphone.
store.everythingInstalled: Everything is on your Home Screen
store.everythingInstalledHint: Remove an app and it comes back here
store.noResultsHint: Try an app's name or what you want to do.
store.builtInHint: Built into the phone itself, so it always stays on your Home Screen.
storeCopy.chirperBody: Follow adventurers across every world, post what you are up to, and catch the timeline between duties.
storeCopy.aethergramBody: Share photos and carousels, post stories that last a day, and message the people you follow.
storeCopy.velvetBody: An 18+ space for connections, collaborative writing and private messages, kept well apart from the rest of your phone.
storeCopy.pollsBody: Put a question to Eorzea and watch the votes land while you wait.
storeCopy.announcementsBody: Release notes, downtime warnings and everything else the Aetherphone team wants you to know, delivered straight to your phone.
storeCopy.venuesBody: Player-run clubs, bars and cafes: see what is open right now, each place's hours for the week and its events, and travel there in one tap.
storeCopy.housingBody: Your world's lottery countdown, open plots in every district, a ward map and a watchlist with reminders before the lottery closes.
storeCopy.musterSub: Call a meetup, see who's coming
storeCopy.musterBody: Announce a spontaneous meetup with a real map location and watch the RSVPs land with one tap. Your friends always see your musters, everyone else can find the public ones, and a muster leaves the list when it ends.
storeCopy.linkpearlBody: Every game chat channel in tabs you build, tells as their own conversations, and pop-out windows that keep chatting while the phone is closed.
storeCopy.messageBody: Message and call the people you have swapped numbers with. Photos, voice notes and group chats included.
storeCopy.cameraBody: Square or full frame shots with a self-timer, saved straight to your library along with the zone they were taken in.
storeCopy.photosBody: Browse by year, month or day, make your own albums, find shots by the place they were taken, and touch them up in the built-in editor.
storeCopy.musicBody: Daily mixes, stations from around the world, your own playlists with synced lyrics, and Jams to listen in sync with friends.
storeCopy.gamesBody: 59 games for queue times with high scores worth chasing, plus eight to play online with friends, from Uno to Mini Golf.
storeCopy.aetherstreamBody: Play videos on your phone or on a screen you place in the world, and watch in sync with nearby Aetherphone users who join your party.
storeCopy.newsBody: Official news on your phone: maintenance with a live countdown in your local time, patch notes and announcements.
storeCopy.fishingBody: Ocean fishing voyages with their routes and blue fish, plus big fish windows with an alert before they open.
storeCopy.skywatcherBody: Living skies for every zone, the odds of each weather and your saved zones, so you are there when the weather you need rolls in.
storeCopy.mapsBody: Every zone map with its aetherytes and markers, and your favorite aetherytes one tap away.
storeCopy.collectionsBody: Mounts, minions, orchestrion rolls and more, with unlock alerts, a wishlist and ideas for what to chase next.
storeCopy.inventoryBody: Find any item across your bags, saddlebag and retainers, add up your gil and what your stash would sell for, and spot split stacks worth merging. Retainers load once you open them in game.
storeCopy.jobsBody: Every job's level and EXP by role, your rested bonus, your own gearset shelves and one tap gear switching.
storeCopy.characterBody: Close three daily rings for experience, duties and gil, keep your streaks going and earn awards for your best days.
storeCopy.walletBody: Your gil, tomestones against the weekly cap and every other currency, with near-cap warnings and a 30 day history for each character.
storeCopy.marketBody: A watchlist with 7 day trends, sale history, prices world by world and an alert when an item drops to your price.
storeCopy.dailiesBody: Game-tracked progress, your own tasks and a checklist for each character, with a reminder before reset.
storeCopy.huntsBody: Live marks and spawn windows on every world of your data center, A rank train routes and alerts for the marks you pick.
storeCopy.notesBody: Notes with pins and search, Reminders with dates, and a Recently Deleted that keeps notes for 30 days.
storeCopy.calendarBody: Your own events in colored groups, repeating weekly or monthly with reminders, plus every in-game event counting down.
storeCopy.timersBody: Countdowns to the daily, weekly and Grand Company resets, Fashion Report, Jumbo Cactpot, ocean fishing and retainer ventures, with optional reminders.
storeCopy.clockBody: World clocks, alarms for your local time or an Eorzean bell, a stopwatch and a timer, with Eorzea time under a sky that follows the bell.
storeCopy.calculatorBody: Type on your keyboard, copy and paste, and look back over a saved history of your sums.
storeCopy.settingsBody: Wallpapers, themes, sounds, language and everything else about the phone.
storeCopy.notificationsBody: Every alert grouped by app and sorted by day. Filter by app, or mute one for an hour or the rest of the day.
storeCopy.feedbackBody: Send a bug report, an idea or some praise, with screenshots attached.
storeCopy.storeBody: Browse everything the phone can do and put it on your Home Screen.
storeCopy.yellowPagesBody: Post an ad once and reach your whole region: venue nights with schedules and an Open Now switch, gil services with prices up front, and recruitment calls for free companies, statics, and venue staff. Ads expire on their own, so the board never goes stale.
conduct.yellowpages.title: Yellow Pages Community Rules
conduct.yellowpages.intro: Before you post an ad, please read the rules of the community.
conduct.yellowpages.allowed.title: What Is Allowed
conduct.yellowpages.allowed.1: Venue nights, game nights, and housing tours with honest schedules
conduct.yellowpages.allowed.2: Crafting, gathering, portraits, glamour, and performance work for gil
conduct.yellowpages.allowed.3: Recruiting for free companies, statics, and venue staff
conduct.yellowpages.allowed.5: Mod ads that show the work and link to the mod page: SFW mods only, no NSFW mods
conduct.yellowpages.allowed.6: Plugin ads only for modding and GPose plugins: QoL, UI, and automation are excluded
conduct.yellowpages.gil.title: Gil Only
conduct.yellowpages.gil.lead: Ads may only ask for gil. The following are never allowed:
conduct.yellowpages.gil.1: Real money, gift cards, or payments taken outside the game
conduct.yellowpages.gil.2: RMT, gil selling, account services, or third-party boosting shops
conduct.yellowpages.gil.3: Selling mods, plugins, or commissions for them: those ads link out and carry no price
conduct.yellowpages.honest.title: Honest Listings
conduct.yellowpages.honest.lead: An ad is a promise to whoever answers it. Do not post:
conduct.yellowpages.honest.1: Fake listings or services you cannot deliver
conduct.yellowpages.honest.2: Prices, schedules, or turnaround times you cannot honor
conduct.yellowpages.honest.3: Impersonating another venue, crafter, or free company
conduct.yellowpages.honest.4: Reposting the same ad to dodge the expiry cycle
conduct.yellowpages.honest.5: Ads left live once the work or event is over
conduct.yellowpages.appropriate.title: Keep It Appropriate
conduct.yellowpages.appropriate.lead: The After Dark tag marks mature venues and late-night events. It is not permission to post:
conduct.yellowpages.appropriate.2: ERP, escort, or sexual solicitation services
conduct.yellowpages.appropriate.4: Explicit language in titles, photos, or ad text
conduct.yellowpages.childSafety.title: Child Safety
conduct.yellowpages.childSafety.body: Any content involving or sexualizing child-like characters or minors is strictly prohibited, regardless of lore or stated age.
conduct.yellowpages.respect.title: Be Respectful
conduct.yellowpages.respect.lead: Treat others with respect. Do not engage in:
conduct.yellowpages.respect.4: Pressuring or badgering someone through inquiries
conduct.yellowpages.respect.5: Impersonation of real people or misinformation intended to deceive
conduct.yellowpages.spam.title: No Spam
conduct.yellowpages.spam.lead: Keep the board worth browsing. Do not post:
conduct.yellowpages.spam.2: Ads filed under unrelated categories or tags
conduct.yellowpages.privacy.title: Protect Privacy
conduct.yellowpages.privacy.body: Do not share another person's personal information, private conversations, or confidential content without their permission.
conduct.yellowpages.creators.title: Respect Creators
conduct.yellowpages.creators.lead: Only upload content you have the right to share. Do not:
conduct.yellowpages.creators.2: Remove watermarks or repost commissioned work without permission
conduct.yellowpages.creators.3: Claim someone else's creations as your own
conduct.yellowpages.discretion.title: Moderator Discretion
conduct.yellowpages.discretion.body: Ads that are misleading, off-topic, or otherwise inappropriate for a public board may be removed at moderator discretion.
yellowpages.setUpAccount: Sign in to browse the classifieds.
yellowpages.emptyHint: Widen the scope or clear the filters, or be the first to post an ad.
yellowpages.modLinkHint: https link to XIV Mod Archive, Heliosphere, Glamour Dresser or GitHub. Mod ads carry a link and photos, never a price.
yellowpages.needModLink: Add a link to the mod page.
yellowpages.noInquiriesHint: Questions about your ads, and the ones you asked about, land here.
yellowpages.inquiryConsentHint: Posting an ad is consent to be asked about it, so this reaches the poster even if their messages are closed.
yellowpages.inquiryLocked: Unlock your encryption key to send inquiries.
yellowpages.inquirySendFailed: Could not send. Their encryption keys are not ready yet.
yellowpages.notifInquiryGeneric: Someone messaged you about one of your ads.
yellowpages.unavailableHint: This ad expired or was taken down.
yellowpages.archetypePlaceHint: A venue or event night: address, weekly schedule, and an Open Now switch you flip at the door.
yellowpages.archetypeServiceHint: Work for gil: crafting, portraits, glamour, performance, coaching. Offer it, or ask for it.
yellowpages.archetypeCallHint: Recruitment: free company, static, venue staff. Or find a group to join.
yellowpages.postRules: Ads run 7 days and renew with one tap in their last 3. 3 live ads per account. Gil only.
yellowpages.scheduleHint: Your clock is {0}. Every reader sees the schedule in their own clock, with the UTC time underneath.
yellowpages.afterDarkHint: Hidden from readers unless they opt in. Keep the ad itself non-explicit.
yellowpages.allowInquiriesHint: Turn this off and nobody can open an inquiry about this ad. Conversations you already have stay open.
yellowpages.needDataCenter: Log in to a world first.
yellowpages.needOpenWindow: Keep the doors open for at least {0} minutes.
yellowpages.errorInvalid: Something in the ad was rejected. Check the fields and try again.
yellowpages.errorRateLimited: You are posting too fast. Give it a minute.
yellowpages.errorFailed: Could not publish the ad. Try again.
yellowpages.mineHint: Ads renew in their last three days, and readers stop seeing them the moment they lapse.
yellowpages.noAdsHint: Post a place, a service, or a recruitment call and it runs for a week.
yellowpages.deleteConfirm: Delete this ad? Its photos and saves go with it.
yellowpages.noSavedHint: Save an ad and it stays here until it expires.
yellowpages.notifHiddenBody: "{0}" was hidden after reports and is pending review.
yellowpages.notifExpiringBody: "{0}" expires within a day. Renew it to keep it listed.
yellowpages.notifExpiringGeneric: One of your ads expires within a day. Renew it to keep it listed.
yellowpages.notifHiddenGeneric: One of your ads was hidden after reports and is pending review.
yellowpages.notifOpenedGeneric: A place you saved is open now.
yellowpages.inquiriesClosedHint: The poster turned off messages for this ad. Use the details above to reach them in game.
yellowpages.afterDarkConfirmBody: Show 18+ ads while browsing? They stay hidden for everyone who has not opted in, and the ads themselves must still be non-explicit.
yellowpages.bodyHint: What you offer, what to expect, and how to reach you in game.
yellowpages.coverAccentHint: Colors the card and the banner when the ad has no photo.
yellowpages.directionHintCall: Recruit for your group, or find one to join.
yellowpages.directionHintService: Offer your work, or ask for someone else's.
yellowpages.intentGoHint: Venues, events, casinos, and open houses
yellowpages.intentJoinHint: Free companies, statics, staff, and communities
yellowpages.intentWantedHint: People asking for a service or a group
yellowpages.lookingForHint: The kind of group, schedule, or content you want
yellowpages.noResultsHint: Try another scope, category, or search.
yellowpages.requirementsHint: Item level, schedule, voice chat, experience
yellowpages.wantedCallHint: You want to join a group
health.title: Health
health.teleportHint: Teleport distance skipped is a same-map straight-line estimate only; cross-zone teleports are counted without distance.
health.resetGoalsMessage: Replace your goals with the defaults?
health.resetAllConfirm: Erase ALL Health data for this character? This cannot be undone.
storeCopy.healthBody: A playful tracker for your character: steps, distance, swims and active time with goals and streaks, a log of their weight, and a water log with gentle reminders for you.
health.notMedical: Health is a playful tracker for your character, not a medical app, and gives no medical advice. Steps, distance and active time are estimated from your character's movement in game, and weight is what you log for them.
health.signedOutTitle: Log in to see your Health
health.signedOutBody: Health follows the character you are playing. Their steps, weight and goals appear once you are logged in.
health.highlightsEmptyBody: After a couple of weeks of history, Health compares this week with the last one here.
health.noDrinksBody: Choose a drink and a serving above, then tap Add. You can remove any entry if you made a mistake.
health.remindersHint: A reminder arrives when you have not logged a drink for that long. Reminders stay silent during quiet hours and, if you like, in combat and duties.
health.highlightWaterUp: You logged more water on average this week than last week.
health.highlightWaterDown: You logged less water on average this week than last week.
health.highlightStepsUp: Your adventurer took more steps on average this week than last week.
health.highlightStepsDown: Your adventurer took fewer steps on average this week than last week.
health.highlightActiveUp: Your adventurer was active for longer on average this week than last week.
health.highlightActiveDown: Your adventurer was active for less time on average this week than last week.
health.highlightSwimUp: Your adventurer swam farther on average this week than last week.
health.highlightSwimDown: Your adventurer swam less on average this week than last week.
health.highlightWeightChange: Your character's weight changed by {0} over the last 30 days.
health.highlightWeightSteady: Your character's weight stayed about the same over the last 30 days.
health.stepsNote: Steps are estimated from the distance your character walks and runs in game, using the stride length in Settings.
health.swimNote: Swimming counts the distance your character swims at the surface and underwater.
health.activeNote: Active time counts the time your character spends walking, running or swimming.
health.streakHint: Your streak grows each day you reach your daily step goal.
health.weightEmptyBody: Log your character's weight now and then to see how it changes over weeks and months.
health.weightNote: Your character's weight log is saved on this PC only, with your plugin settings. The optional energy estimate uses the latest entry.
health.goalsEmptyBody: Tap the plus button to set a target for steps, water, swimming and more.
health.goalsHint: Daily goals start over at midnight, weekly goals on Sunday, and session goals each time you log in.
health.adventurerHint: These shape how Health reads your character's movement: steps are distance on foot divided by stride, and the optional energy estimate uses their latest logged weight.
health.notifyWaterBody: Time for a glass of water.
health.welcomeBody: A playful health tracker for your character: how far they roam, swim and stay active, their weight over time, and a gentle nudge for you to drink water while you play.
health.featureWaterBody: Log a drink in one tap, here or from a home screen widget, with gentle reminders.
health.featureWeightBody: Log your character's weight whenever it changes and see the trend over weeks and months.
health.featureStepsBody: Your character's walks, runs and swims become steps and distance, with goals and streaks.
share.title: Share to
share.noTargets: No apps can open this yet
settings.importScreenshotsHint: Copy screenshots you take into the Photos gallery, including ones from ReShade and GShade. Only shots taken while the phone is running are copied, and the originals stay where they are.
settings.monthlyAlbumsHint: Add an album for each month to the Albums tab in Photos automatically. Photos asks once the first time you open Albums.
social.feedSuggestedTaste: Liked by people with your taste
social.feedSuggestedFresh: New post, you are among the first to see it
social.feedHowItWorksIntro: For You shows the posts you have not seen yet, in the order we think you will enjoy them. Latest is every post, newest first, and it is always one tap away.
social.feedHowItWorksQuality: A post rises on how the people who saw it responded, never on how many followers its author has. Comments and replies count far more than a heart.
social.feedHowItWorksPeople: People you interact with, and players who like the same posts you do, lift what appears for you.
social.feedHowItWorksFair: Posting hour does not decide reach. A post made while most players are asleep waits for them instead of expiring, and every new post is shown to a few people before it competes on numbers.
social.pinReplaceMessage: You can pin up to {0} posts. Pinning this one unpins the post you pinned first.
social.archiveEmptyHint: Posts you archive leave your profile and wait here until you show them again.
social.pinChatLimit: You can pin up to {0} chats.
moderation.notice.removedMessage: A message you sent was removed
moderation.notice.profileCleared: Part of your profile was removed
moderation.notice.profileClearedIntro: We removed part of your profile because it violated our {0} policy.
moderation.notice.suspendedIntro: Your account has been temporarily suspended.
moderation.notice.suspendedFor: You can sign in again after {0}.
moderation.notice.suspendedPermanent: This suspension does not expire on its own.
moderation.notice.signedOutBody: Your sessions were ended on every device. Your account is fine and nothing was removed.
moderation.notice.warningConsequence: Please follow the community guidelines. Repeated breaks of the same rule can lead to a temporary suspension.
moderation.notice.thanksBody: A moderator reviewed your report. Thank you for sending it.
moderation.notice.badgeBodyOne: You received the {0} badge. It now shows next to your name, and you can manage it in Settings under Account.
moderation.notice.badgeBodyMany: You received new badges: {0}. They now show next to your name, and you can manage them in Settings under Account.
moderation.notice.badgeBodyFallback: You received a new badge. You can see it in Settings under Account.
moderation.notice.badgeRevokedBodyOne: The {0} badge was removed from your account and no longer shows next to your name. If you think this was a mistake, reach out to us on our Discord server.
moderation.notice.badgeRevokedBodyMany: These badges were removed from your account: {0}. They no longer show next to your name. If you think this was a mistake, reach out to us on our Discord server.
moderation.notice.badgeRevokedBodyFallba: A badge was removed from your account. If you think this was a mistake, reach out to us on our Discord server.
moderation.notice.frameBodyOne: You received the {0} frame. Wear it from Aether Coin, under Items.
moderation.notice.frameBodyFallback: You received a new avatar frame. Wear it from Aether Coin, under Items.
moderation.notice.frameRevokedBodyOne: The {0} frame was removed from your account and no longer sits around your picture. If you think this was a mistake, reach out to us on our Discord server.
moderation.notice.frameRevokedBodyMany: These frames were removed from your account: {0}. They no longer sit around your picture. If you think this was a mistake, reach out to us on our Discord server.
moderation.notice.frameRevokedBodyFallba: An avatar frame was removed from your account. If you think this was a mistake, reach out to us on our Discord server.
moderation.notice.nameResetIntro: A moderator reset the name you go by, so it is back to the random handle a new account starts with. Open Settings and pick a new one whenever you like.
safety.title: Moderation and safety
safety.empty: Your account has no warnings, restrictions, suspensions, or other moderation actions.
safety.signInPrompt: Sign in to see moderation notices for your account.
safety.retentionHint: Notices stay here for 180 days, whether or not you have read them.
account.ban.lifts: Your social apps are temporarily locked. You can sign in again after {0}.
aetherstream.supportedSitesHint: Works with YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Dailymotion, direct video links and many more sites. Netflix, Disney+ and other DRM services can't play.
aetherstream.clearQueueConfirm: Remove every video waiting in the queue?
aetherstream.castingScreenPositionHint: Start playback to move and resize the screen.
aetherstream.settingsDependencyRestartPe: Installed, applies after restarting the game
aetherstream.settingsDiscoverableHint: Players in the same zone can find your stream under Nearby. Off keeps it to people you invite, though the screen itself stays visible.
aetherstream.settingsShareWatchPresenceH: Off keeps your name out of the watching list on this screen.
aetherstream.settingsApprovalRequiredHin: New viewers must be approved by you before they can watch. Applies the next time you go live.
aetherstream.settingsHardwareDecodingHin: Off is the safe default - there's no GPU render path under Wine either way.
aetherstream.settingsTls: Allow insecure direct video URLs (Wine only)
aetherstream.settingsTlsHint: Unsafe: skips certificate checks for direct links. Leave off unless a link fails to load.
aetherstream.joinSearchFailed: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
aetherstream.streamUnavailableBody: That party can't be joined right now.
aetherstream.joinDeniedBody: The host declined your request to join.
aetherstream.suggestHint: Suggest a video to the host
aetherstream.queueSuggestionAcceptedBody: The host added your suggestion to the queue.
aetherstream.queueSuggestionDeniedBody: The host didn't add your suggestion.
aetherstream.suggestionNotifyBody: {0} suggested a video for the queue.
aetherstream.infoIntro: How MogCast plays videos, and what to try when one won't.
aetherstream.infoVpnBody: Video sites often block VPN and proxy connections. If videos refuse to load or keep failing, try again with the VPN off, or switch to another server.
aetherstream.infoStartupBody: Every link is resolved before it plays, so a new video needs a few seconds to start. The first video after installing also downloads the player components.
aetherstream.infoSitesLead: Hundreds of sites work, plus direct video links and your own files.
aetherstream.infoFailuresBody: Video sites change constantly. MogCast keeps yt-dlp up to date on its own, retries stubborn streams, and tells you why a link failed. Direct video links are the most reliable.
aetherstream.infoPartiesBody: Everyone plays the same link on their own phone, so it has to be reachable for every viewer. For a file from your own machine, each viewer picks their own copy of the same file.
aetherstream.kickedBody: The host removed you from the party.
aetherstream.localWatchTitle: The host is playing a local file
aetherstream.localWatchHint: Pick your own copy of this file to watch along in sync.
aetherstream.localWatchNoFileHint: Don't have the file? Ask the host to send it to you, then locate it here.
aetherstream.localWatchMismatch: That file does not match the host's copy.
aetherstream.setupBody: Three components let your phone play video in game. They download once and stay on your machine.
aetherstream.setupLinkResolverDetail: Turns a page link into a playable video.
aetherstream.setupJsRuntimeDetail: Answers the checks the video service asks for.
aetherstream.upNextEmptyHint: Anything you add lands here and plays in order.
aetherstream.resolverRecovering: The video service refused the stream. Updating the link resolver and retrying.
aetherstream.resolverStillRefused: The video service refused this stream even after a link resolver update. Try again later.
aetherstream.resolverAlreadyCurrent: The video service refused this stream and the link resolver is already the latest release. Try again later.
aetherstream.resolverUpdateFailed: The video service refused this stream and the link resolver update did not go through. Check your connection and try again.
aetherstream.streamStalledRecovering: The stream stalled. Restarting playback where it left off.
aetherstream.playbackFailed: This video could not be played.
aetherstream.componentsMissing: The video components are not installed yet.
aetherstream.failureStalledBody: The stream stopped twice in a row. Retry picks it up from where it stopped.
aetherstream.failureBotCheckBody: YouTube wants this connection to sign in to prove it is not a bot. Quick retries make the check last longer: wait a few minutes, or turn off any VPN, then retry.
aetherstream.failureDrmBody: Netflix, Disney+, Plex and similar services protect their videos with DRM, so they only play in their own player.
aetherstream.failureRegionBody: The site blocks this video where you are.
aetherstream.failureLoginBody: The site only plays this for signed-in accounts, and MogCast can't sign in for you. Try a public link instead.
aetherstream.failureUnsupportedBody: This site isn't supported. YouTube, Twitch, Kick, Dailymotion and direct video links work best.
aetherstream.failureSiteChangedBody: The site changed how it serves videos. MogCast checks for a fix on its own, and fixes usually arrive within a few days.
aetherstream.failureViewersHint: Skip to the next video, or queue a link that works for everyone.
aetherstream.notALink: That doesn't look like a link or a file.
aetherstream.suggestLinksOnly: Only links can be shared with a party.
aetherstream.playlistLinkTitle: This video is part of a playlist
aetherstream.playlistImportedCapped: {0} videos added, the most one playlist can bring in
aetherstream.playlistImportFailed: That playlist could not be loaded.
aetherstream.playlistDeleteConfirm: Delete {0}? Your queue and history keep their videos.
aetherstream.playlistsEmptyHint: Paste a YouTube playlist link and it lands here, or save your queue as a playlist.
aetherstream.historyEmptyHint: Videos you play show up here, ready to pick up where you left off.
aetherstream.promptHint: Paste a link from YouTube or any video page, or pick a file from your computer.
aetherstream.promptSuggestHint: Paste a link and it goes to the host of your party.
aetherstream.standbyViewer: Waiting for {0} to pick the next video.
aetherstream.standbyHostOpen: Nothing is playing. Your party stays open.
aetherstream.standbyHostGrace: Nothing is playing. The party stays open for {0}.
aetherstream.tracksNone: This video has no extra audio tracks or subtitles.
aetherstream.partyLobbyHint: Start a party and everyone watches the same second of the same video. Friends can join from any world with your invite code.
aetherstream.partySignInHint: Sign in to Aethernet in Settings to host or join a watch party.
aetherstream.codeShape: A code is six letters and numbers.
aetherstream.codeNotFoundBody: That code doesn't match an open party. Check it with whoever sent it.
aetherstream.partyFullBody: That party has no room left right now.
aetherstream.findFriendHint: You can join a contact who is watching something right now.
aetherstream.guestsCanAddHint: Off, a guest's video waits for you to accept it. On, it goes straight into the queue.
aetherstream.guestsCanControlHint: Lets every guest play, pause, seek and skip for the whole party.
aetherstream.inviteCodeHint: Anyone with the code can join, from any world or data center.
aetherstream.endPartyConfirm: End the party for everyone watching?
aetherstream.makeHostConfirm: Hand the party to {0}? They take over the queue and playback, and you stay to watch.
aetherstream.hostQueueAddHint: Add a video and it goes straight into the party's queue.
aetherstream.placeInWorldHint: Drag the colored handles on the screen itself to slide, turn and resize it.
aetherstream.rememberPlacementHint: The next time you watch here, the screen goes back to where you left it.
aetherstream.followHostScreenHint: On, your screen sits where the host placed theirs. Off, you place your own.
aetherstream.hostScreenFarAway: The host's screen is somewhere else, so yours is placed near you.
aetherstream.chatBubblesHint: Messages from game chat pop up over the screen while you watch.
aetherstream.spatialAudioHint: The video gets quieter as you walk away from the screen.
aetherstream.settingsMuteInBackgroundHin: Silences the video while the game window is not in front.
aetherstream.infoCodesBody: Turn on the invite code in Party Settings and share it. Anyone who has it can join from any world or data center, and each person gets a screen where they are standing.
aetherstream.settingsNightlyResolverHint: Uses the nightly yt-dlp, which picks up fixes for broken sites days sooner.

storeCopy.casinoBody: Blackjack, slots, scratch cards, bingo and a communal wheel, played with chips from Aether Coin. Nothing here has cash value.
