changelog.r1006.0: Music and MogCast play songs again, after a change at YouTube left every track failing to load while search kept working
changelog.r1006.1: Photos sent in Velvet and the other chat apps no longer turn into a grey box after a while, and scrolling back to one no longer downloads it again
changelog.r1006.2: Chinese and Japanese now show every character, instead of leaving blank gaps where the text should be
changelog.r1006.3: Switching the phone's language now finishes in one short load, with the whole new alphabet ready straight away
changelog.r1007.0: The Aether Pot has been rebuilt: it now grows for days instead of hours, pays far bigger when it lands, and restarts from a funded reserve instead of zero. Every chip staked buys the same share of the draw, so small spins and big ones are priced alike
changelog.r1007.1: Bingo prizes are now sized to the hall: a quiet room pays the same fair return as a packed one, and a stage prize still always grows as more cards join
changelog.r1007.2: Round verification understands the pot's new draw, so fresh slots rounds check out end to end just like old ones
changelog.r1009.0: Added Hunts, an app that tracks hunt marks across your data center: see at a glance which spawn windows are open, capped or closed, filter by rank, world, status and expansion, and open a mark for its zone map, spawn condition, lore and rewards. One tap travels you there and plants the flag, a notification calls out a spawn the moment it goes up, and a built-in guide explains how the windows work. Live spawn data comes from Faloop and needs a free account, contributed by Deldee
changelog.r1009.1: Housing now covers the Chinese worlds: all four data centers and their worlds appear in the world picker under China, contributed by NiGuangOwO
changelog.r1009.2: The MogCast screen in the world shows up for players running DLSS, FSR or a lowered 3D resolution, instead of staying invisible until upscaling was switched off
changelog.r1009.3: MogCast picks a long video back up when the picture freezes or the sound drops out, and when a link will not play it says why in a plain sentence instead of showing raw error text
changelog.r1009.4: Dragging to scroll no longer snaps a list to one end when the same tap opens a new screen, or stalls when the drag passes over the Dynamic Island or a notification banner, contributed by Deldee
changelog.r1009.5: The notifications list in Settings is sorted by app name in your language, contributed by Deldee
changelog.r1010.0: Posts and comments written in another language now carry a Translate link in Chirper, Aethergram and Velvet: one tap swaps in the translation, a footer names the language it came from, and Show original brings the text back
changelog.r1010.1: Chats in ChocoChat, Aethergram and Velvet can translate a single message from its menu, and a Translate this chat switch in the thread header translates every new message as it arrives
changelog.r1010.2: Settings > Language picks the language you translate into, defaulting to your phone language. Translations are made by Aethernet, only the text you translate is sent, and private messages are never stored
changelog.r1010.3: A MogCast host can play a local file in a watch party without sharing its path: viewers are asked to locate their own copy, the phone checks it matches the host's, and playback runs in sync from there
changelog.r1010.4: Viewers in a MogCast watch party keep pace by speeding up or slowing down slightly instead of jumping on every host update, and only seek when they drift more than three seconds
changelog.r1010.5: When a MogCast video will not play, a card says so with Retry and, for the host, Skip: a stalled stream resumes from where it stopped, and the host sees how many viewers cannot play the current video
changelog.r1010.6: Added Skyfall to Games: tap the sky to send an interceptor that bursts and sweeps every meteor inside, and keep six settlements standing wave after wave
changelog.r1010.7: Added Invaders to Games: a rank marches down on your cannon and four bunkers, speeding up as it thins, with a saucer worth 300 crossing the top now and then
changelog.r1010.8: Added CapMan to Games: eat every dot in the maze, dodge four ghosts with habits of their own, and turn on them for a few seconds with a power pellet
changelog.r1010.9: Added Hop to Games: hop a critter across traffic and drifting pads to fill five dens before the timer runs out, with faster lanes every level
changelog.r1010.10: Added Squadron to Games: shoot ships that peel off their formation in dive runs, and free a fighter caught by a tractor beam to fly as a dual fighter
changelog.r1010.11: Tetris now steers with WASD as well as the arrows: A and D move, W rotates, S soft drops
changelog.r1010.12: Keys pressed in a game now stay in the game: the arrows in Tetris and Sudoku and WASD in the new games no longer walk your character
changelog.r1010.13: The Translate link also sits under profile bios and Velvet intros, Yellow Pages ads, Muster descriptions, Venues descriptions, and story captions
changelog.r1010.14: Settings > General gains Auto-translate posts and comments, which translates posts and comments in another language as soon as they appear, without tapping Translate; chats keep their own per-chat switch
changelog.r1010.15: Added Doom to Games: the real engine runs on the phone in fullscreen landscape, played on the keyboard with WASD, the arrows or a drag to turn, Space, E and 1 to 7
changelog.r1010.16: Added Word Run to Games: guess five-letter words one after another until one beats you, faster solves pay more, with word banks in five languages plus names from the game
changelog.r1010.17: Tetris gains a Modern ruleset beside Classic, with SRS kicks, lock delay, T-spins, back-to-back and combo scoring, and its own best score
changelog.r1033.0: Rewrote the community rules to be shorter: they now list what must be marked sensitive and what is not allowed
changelog.r1033.1: Added a Badge progress page under More on your own profile: your followers and likes against that app's badge and Verified
changelog.r1033.3: Added an AI Usage block to the community rules: content made by generative AI is not allowed
changelog.r1033.4: Moved the photo shape choice when posting into a labeled row under the preview, so Square, Portrait and Landscape are one tap away
changelog.r1033.5: Added Show sensitive grams to the feed filters: turn it off to keep grams marked sensitive out of your feeds
changelog.r1033.6: Fixed the X on a photo tag not removing the tag
changelog.r1033.7: Improved stability: currency amounts are now read in step with the game instead of while the screen draws, contributed by Deldee
changelog.r1036.0: Added a repeat cadence to place ads: a venue can open every week or every 2 to 8 weeks, and you pick the week it starts
changelog.r1036.1: Fixed an ad's Where section showing less of the address than the New ad screen
changelog.r1038.0: Redesigned Support Aetherphone into a card with two ways to support the project: Patreon and Buy Me a Coffee
changelog.r1039.0: The number on the Velvet icon now includes likes, comments and comment likes on your posts
changelog.r1039.1: Fixed Back from a chat opened through a notification jumping to another tab instead of your inbox
changelog.r1039.2: Fixed new message banners showing up to 30 seconds late, in ChocoChat, Aethergram, Velvet and Yellow Pages
changelog.r1039.3: Typing indicators now appear right away, in ChocoChat, Aethergram, Velvet and Yellow Pages
changelog.r1039.4: Fixed the Velvet and Yellow Pages icons sometimes leaving older unread notifications out of their count
changelog.r1039.5: Fixed an issue where the phone could show 'Too many requests. Retrying in Ns' when switching between chats; background communication with the server is now much lighter
changelog.r1039.6: Changed the backend infrastructure to be more secure and work more efficiently
changelog.r1040.0: If the Lodestone can't confirm your character, Velvet now says why and lets you try again
changelog.r1040.2: Cached images are now stored encrypted on your PC, and you can clear them in Settings > Privacy; signing out clears them too
changelog.r1040.3: Image-heavy apps load more smoothly and use less bandwidth when you scroll quickly
changelog.r1041.0: Overhauled MogCast from top to bottom: three tabs for Watch, Party and Library, a single button to add videos, and a simpler player
changelog.r1041.1: Rebuilt the Screen page around a top-down stage: drag the screen across the floor, turn it by its handle, and see how far its sound carries
changelog.r1041.2: Added invite codes to watch parties, so friends on any world or data center can join
changelog.r1041.3: Added guest permissions: let everyone add videos or control playback, or allow it for one member at a time
changelog.r1041.4: Added host handover: make another member the host, and the party passes to someone else by itself if the host disconnects
changelog.r1041.5: Added YouTube playlists: paste a playlist link to queue the whole list, and it is saved to your Library
changelog.r1041.6: Added watch history with resume, a Continue watching row, and saving your queue as a playlist
changelog.r1041.7: Added audio track and subtitle selection for videos that carry more than one
changelog.r1041.8: Added handles on the in-world screen to move, turn and resize it, along with fine nudges and a curve slider that goes from flat to deeply curved
changelog.r1041.9: Added chat bubbles on the screen for Say, Party, Free Company and Shout
changelog.r1041.11: Added sound that fades with distance from the screen, and an option to mute MogCast while the game is in the background
changelog.r1041.12: Parties now stay open for five minutes on a dark screen when the queue runs out, instead of closing
changelog.r1041.13: The screen now remembers where you placed it in each location
changelog.r1041.14: Fixed local files not playing when their path was pasted with quotes around it
changelog.r1300.0: Added Texas Hold'em: no-limit tables against other players, at three house stakes or at a table you host
changelog.r1300.1: Added Chocobo race: eight birds with posted odds, Win, Place and Forecast bets, and every race run live to the line
changelog.r1300.2: Added Plinko: drop balls through 8, 12 or 16 rows of pegs at low, medium or high risk
changelog.r1300.3: Added Mines: uncover safe tiles on a five by five board and cash out before you find a mine
changelog.r1300.4: Added Dice: set your win chance, roll over or under it, and win the multiplier it sets
changelog.r1300.5: Added Limbo: name a target multiplier and win when the result climbs past it
changelog.r1300.6: Added Keno: pick up to ten numbers and watch ten get drawn
changelog.r1300.7: Added Hi-Lo: call the next card higher or lower and cash out whenever you like
changelog.r1300.8: Added Golden Bird Deluxe: five reels and free spins where one symbol expands to fill its reels
changelog.r1300.9: Added Crystal Cascade: eight or more of a kind pay anywhere, then the winners shatter and the rest tumble down
changelog.r1300.10: Added Moogle Money: six pom coins start a hold and spin, and a full grid pays the Grand
changelog.r1300.11: Added Dice table: everyone at the table rolls with one tap, and every roll lands in a shared log
changelog.r1300.12: Added Deathroll: two players take turns rolling under the last roll, and whoever rolls 1 loses
changelog.r1300.13: Added Raffle: the host opens a raffle, members take tickets, and one fair draw picks the winner
changelog.r1300.14: Added free chip bonuses: a welcome gift, a timed bonus every 3 hours, a 7-day streak, level rewards and a top-up when you run out
changelog.r1300.15: Added levels: every bet earns experience, and each level raises your bet ceiling
changelog.r1300.16: Added Gamba Club: tiers from Bronze to Obsidian raise your bonuses, with a weekly rebate from Silver
changelog.r1300.17: Added daily missions: three a day, each paying chips when you finish it
changelog.r1300.18: Added floor challenges with a chip prize and the current leader on the Floor
changelog.r1300.19: Added the Hall of Fame: weekly boards for profit, best multiplier and biggest win, naming only players who allow leaderboards
changelog.r1300.20: Added chip rain: now and then, chips drop on everyone in a live room
changelog.r1300.21: Added practice tables: play on practice chips that never touch your bankroll
changelog.r1300.22: Added gil tables: the host banks the table in gil, and every buy-in and payout goes in a ledger both sides confirm
changelog.r1300.23: Added house rules for practice and gil blackjack: the blackjack payout, soft 17, decks, splits and doubles
changelog.r1300.24: Added a dealer seat: the host can deal without playing a hand, with up to three co-dealers
changelog.r1300.25: Added a session ledger with each seat's buy-ins, stack and net, which the host can copy as text
changelog.r1300.26: Added trade sync: after you trade gil with a seated player, the matching ledger entry waits for one tap
changelog.r1300.27: Added nearby tables: tables at the venue you stand in show first, and Venues shows a venue's live table
changelog.r1300.28: Added a broadcast view: a large landscape blackjack table for a second screen or the bar's display
changelog.r1300.29: Added blackjack tournaments on practice tables: equal stacks, a set number of hands, out at zero
changelog.r1300.30: Added insurance and surrender to blackjack
changelog.r1300.31: Added Pairs and 21+3 side bets to blackjack
changelog.r1300.32: Added the blackjack pit: pick a house table by stakes, a hosted table or a quick seat
changelog.r1300.33: Added Instant mode and Auto play with stops on profit and loss
changelog.r1300.34: Added a Bets sheet with your bets, all bets and high rollers, where each of your rounds can be checked
changelog.r1300.35: Added a check-in every 100 rounds or 30 minutes with your session net

changelog.r1020.56: Give it about a week. The feed learns from what people actually read and react to, so it gets better as it goes
changelog.r1020.67: The day's events under the month grid now scroll instead of stopping after the three that fit, so a busy day shows all of them
changelog.r1020.57: Notes now wraps a long line onto the next line instead of running it off the side of the screen, and the wrap is only for reading: the note is stored exactly as you typed it
changelog.r1020.58: Added a copy button to a note, so what you paste elsewhere comes out as the clean paragraphs you wrote
changelog.r10110.0: Fixed an issue where the phone was causing Too many requests errors, background communication with the server is now much lighter
changelog.r1019.0: Added caption editing: choose Edit caption from the menu on one of your posts to fix the text without deleting the post and losing its likes and comments
changelog.r1019.1: Posts with an edited caption show an Edited mark next to the timestamp
changelog.r1019.2: Added an app switcher: hold the home bar for a moment and every app you left mid-use lines up as a live preview card, tap one to jump back in
changelog.r1019.3: Swipe a card up in the switcher to close that app, or tap Close All to have every app start from its first screen next time
changelog.r1019.4: The switcher row glides with a flick, snaps to the nearest card, and arrows on both sides step through one app at a time
changelog.r1019.5: Added clean shots: the game interface is hidden in your photos by default, with a button next to the shutter to keep it visible, contributed by Radvo
changelog.r1019.6: Zone maps are now read straight from the game client and open fitted to the spawn cluster, contributed by Deldee
changelog.r1019.7: Fixed spawn tips that could show up in the wrong language
changelog.r1019.8: Water Sort now pours from a colorblind-friendly palette: every liquid differs in both hue and brightness, so shades that used to look alike are easier to tell apart
changelog.r1019.9: Fixed blank player names in Play with friends rooms: a player who never set a display name now shows their handle on the seat card, in the turn text, and on the room card
changelog.r1019.10: Fixed blank player names at the tables for players who never set a display name, their handle is shown instead
changelog.r1019.11: Music playlists can now shuffle: a new button next to Play all plays the list in random order, and the shuffle toggle in the player mixes whatever is queued
changelog.r1018.0: Fixed an issue where tall portrait photos were cropped in the feed, the post frame now matches the photo's shape and shows the whole picture
changelog.r1018.1: Copy Support Info in Settings > About now collects everything needed for bug reports on our Discord server
changelog.r1018.2: The Followers and Following lists now show the exact count under the title, so you can see the real number behind rounded stats like 1.5K
changelog.r1017.0: Fixed an issue where tapping the like count under a post liked or unliked it instead of opening the Liked by list
changelog.r1016.0: Overhauled the app from top to bottom: a home feed with For You and Following tabs, an explore grid under Search, a rebuilt profile, post page, inbox and threads, a new compose flow, and Settings, Activity and Follow requests to match
changelog.r1016.1: Added a Posts screen to Aethergram: tapping a tile on a profile, tagged, saved, hashtag or explore grid scrolls through that whole collection, starting at the tapped post
changelog.r1016.2: Added emoji reactions to messages in every messaging app: the quick strip keeps the six favorites and a + opens the full emoji drawer
changelog.r1016.3: Added GIF sending to direct messages: GIFs now upload as GIFs (up to 4 MB) and play in the bubble and the viewer instead of being flattened into a still image
changelog.r1016.13: Improved @mention and Tag people suggestions: they now match anywhere in a handle or display name instead of only the start of the handle, with handle matches ranked first
changelog.r1016.14: Added new avatar frames to the shop, contributed by noxbatty
changelog.r1016.4: Fixed an issue where emoji in image captions, shared post snippets and story captions showed as :shortcodes: instead of emoji
changelog.r1016.5: Fixed an issue where the emoji drawer stayed open after tapping outside it while composing
changelog.r1016.6: Fixed an issue where a link that followed text in a Linkpearl message could not be opened
changelog.r1016.7: Fixed an issue where location shares sent from inside a house showed no place name
changelog.r1016.8: Fixed an issue where an equipped avatar frame spilled over the Aethergram profile name and the screen edge, and squeezed the follower counts until their labels clipped
changelog.r1016.9: Fixed an issue where tall or wide photos sat letterboxed in the Aethergram feed, the post now fills with the photo and the viewer still shows the whole picture
changelog.r1016.10: Fixed an issue where story tray names wrapped letter by letter when a tile slid under the screen edge
changelog.r1016.11: Fixed an issue where the Aethergram thread header cut the other person's name short
changelog.r1016.12: Fixed an issue where the emoji and photo buttons in the Aethergram and Chirper comment composer left the field too narrow to show its hint
changelog.r1015.0: Fixed an issue where pressing Previous, Next or Pause on the Dynamic Island's music card opened the Music app instead of controlling playback
changelog.r1014.0: Fixed Chirper no longer offering the Translate link on posts and replies written in another language
changelog.r1014.1: Tapping the reaction pill under a Chirper post now joins its reaction, and a pill holding several reactions expands into one chip per reaction so you can pick the one to add
changelog.r1014.2: Fixed the phone creeping away from its place after each turn to landscape and back, each orientation now remembers its own resting spot
changelog.r1014.3: Fixed Linkpearl pop-out menus staying open and out of reach after that window lost focus
changelog.r1014.4: The Gamba rules and Payouts sheets now explain the ten Slots paylines and how the house jackpot draw works
changelog.r1014.5: Fixed the Slots jackpot meter reading full long before the pot reached its 50,000 coin cap
changelog.r1014.6: Fixed long Slots banners and the jackpot hint clipping at the cabinet edge, they now glide across instead
changelog.r1014.7: The Slots reel window now shakes, flashes gold and runs a chase of marquee bulbs when the jackpot lands
changelog.r1014.8: Added three new phone cases: Emet-Selch, Bubbles and Warrior, contributed by mapleterra and kingzafar
changelog.r1014.9: Apps now answer taps while they are still opening, and a swipe on the home indicator mid-open sends them straight back instead of waiting for the animation to finish
changelog.r1014.10: Drag the home indicator upward to shrink an app with the cursor, then let go to close it or drop it back into place
changelog.r1014.11: The home screen icons now fade away while an app grows out of them, and the app's content only appears once its card is large enough to read
changelog.r1014.13: Improved app opening: the wallpaper now zooms and blurs behind the growing app card instead of only dimming
changelog.r1014.14: Fixed the Chirper Home, Explore, Activity and Profile tabs sharing one scroll position, each tab now keeps its own place
changelog.r1014.12: Who reacted to a Chirper post now lives under View reactions in the post's More menu
changelog.r1013.0: Redesigned Chirper around Home, Explore, Activity and Profile tabs, with edge to edge posts, threaded replies and a new compose pill
changelog.r1013.1: Chirper now shows profile pictures on posts, a banner on profiles, and which reaction each person left in the likers list
changelog.r1013.2: Chirper tabs now refresh when you come back to them, and name effects play everywhere in the app
changelog.r1013.3: Added search to the home screen: pull down on the app grid to find apps, settings, messages, notes and shortcuts, or do quick math
changelog.r1013.4: Apps now come back where you left them, keeping their tab, draft, screen and scroll
changelog.r1013.5: Apps now draw placeholder rows while their first page loads, instead of a spinner
changelog.r1013.6: Added MogCast, Music, News and Hunts to the Chinese game version
changelog.r1013.46: The Simplified Chinese translation has been polished across the phone, from app names to Eorzean units and the moderation wording, contributed by Nero0421
changelog.r1013.7: Mods has been taken out of the phone, browsing and installing Heliosphere mods happens in the Heliosphere plugin
changelog.r1013.8: Beat can now be played with the keyboard, on 1 to 4 or A, S, D and F
changelog.r1013.9: Added a Trademark document and refreshed the official Aetherphone documents in the GitHub repository
changelog.r1013.10: Chat pop-outs now hold several conversations as tabs, merge when you drag one window onto another, and fold down to their title bar
changelog.r1013.11: Chat pop-outs can now hide in combat and in duties, fade while you are away, and come back when you are free
changelog.r1013.12: A hotkey now opens your recent chats as pop-outs, and right clicking a player in the game starts one
changelog.r1013.13: The game chat composer now takes several lines, splits a message too long for the game into paced parts, keeps a draft per conversation and runs slash commands
changelog.r1013.14: Emoji shortcodes now draw as emoji in game chat, with a picker and favourites in the composer. Other players still receive the shortcode
changelog.r1013.15: Every game chat channel can now carry its own colors, stay out of your unread count, hide your own lines, or show only on the phone
changelog.r1013.16: The player menu on a chat line now also offers a friend request, the adventurer plate, targeting and the blacklist
changelog.r1013.17: Chat settings now open as a list of screens instead of one long scroll
changelog.r1013.18: The game's boxed numbers, arrows and quality marks now draw in Linkpearl instead of being stripped out
changelog.r1013.19: Fixed a link clicked in a chat pop-out asking on the phone screen instead of in that window
changelog.r1013.20: You can now unlock a new PC from one that already opens your chats, with your key and full history following
changelog.r1013.21: Messages you have already read are now kept on this PC, sealed the same way your key is
changelog.r1013.22: Saving your recovery code is now two steps, with a notification while a code is waiting to be saved
changelog.r1013.23: Added an encryption help panel that explains what each message state means and what to do about it
changelog.r1013.24: Fixed the phone losing or replacing your encryption key, the cause behind conversations turning unreadable
changelog.r1013.25: A chat this device cannot decrypt no longer sends in the clear
changelog.r1013.26: A fresh phone now starts with a curated Control Center
changelog.r1013.27: A fresh install now opens the phone minimized at login
changelog.r1013.28: The minimized phone is now yours to arrange: pick which pieces it shows and in what order, with widgets for Eorzea time, weather, resets, gil and ventures
changelog.r1013.29: A running Clock timer now shows in the Dynamic Island
changelog.r1013.47: A shortcut can now use a picture from your PC as its icon, moved and scaled to fit the tile, contributed by Deldee
changelog.r1013.30: Added sounds across the phone and the mini-games, with Silent Mode on the main Settings page and volumes under Settings > Sounds
changelog.r1013.31: Moved Show in Group Pose into General settings
changelog.r1013.32: Row and post menus and destructive confirmations now open as bottom sheets
changelog.r1013.33: Lists and feeds now run edge to edge with hairline separators and one shared row layout
changelog.r1013.45: Linkpearl's icons are larger and its chat lists now run bezel to bezel, in step with the rest of the phone
changelog.r1013.44: Fixed the older key notice staying up in a chat after those messages had already come back
changelog.r1013.34: Buttons now shrink while held and fire when you release, and toasts always appear on the phone
changelog.r1013.35: Improved the animation when the phone turns into landscape
changelog.r1013.36: External links in Music now ask before they open your browser
changelog.r1013.37: Improved rendering, memory use and text heavy screens across the phone, so long chats and feeds scroll more smoothly
changelog.r1013.38: Fixed a fresh install holding on the boot screen, and text resizing the first time an app drew a new icon
changelog.r1013.39: Fixed the clock, status icons and home bar drawing almost white on light app backgrounds
changelog.r1013.40: Fixed the other side's chat bubbles being nearly invisible in light mode
changelog.r1013.41: Fixed the glossy highlight on panels ending in a hard line short of their rounded corners
changelog.r1013.42: Gil figures and viewer counts now follow your language's number formatting
changelog.r1013.43: Chats sealed to a key you no longer have now come back on their own, handed over by the people you were talking to
changelog.r1013.48: Fixed the compose button covering the scrollbar beside it in Aethergram, Chirper, Velvet, Photos, Muster and Message, so that bar can be dragged again, contributed by Farroness
changelog.r1012.0: Added Mods, a Heliosphere browser: search the catalog by name or category, sort by trending, downloads or date, and read each mod's images, changelog and permissions without leaving the game
changelog.r1012.1: Installing and updating from Mods goes through the Heliosphere plugin, so creators keep their download counts and the phone never touches Penumbra's mod folder
changelog.r1012.2: The Installed tab in Mods lists your Heliosphere mods with their covers, flags the ones with an update, and switches them on or off in your collection
changelog.r1012.3: NSFW mods stay hidden until you turn them on in Mods settings and confirm you are 18 or older, and sensitive previews stay blurred until tapped
changelog.r1012.4: The minimized phone is a little phone again: a portrait puck with its case art, a big clock with the date, and music, calls and new notifications stacked underneath like a lock screen
changelog.r1011.0: Added Strats, an app with raid cheatsheets: pick a fight and your role, and every mechanic comes with a diagram that marks your spot
changelog.r1011.1: Games has a new home: shelves by genre, Latest additions and Jump back in rails, a Play with friends card, and a search across every title
changelog.r1011.2: Added Uno to Games: an online room for up to six friends, joined with a six-character code
changelog.r1011.3: Added online Chess to Games: host or join a room by code, with Fischer clocks for both players
changelog.r1011.4: Added 8-Ball Pool to Games: the phone turns sideways for the table, and you shoot by dragging away from the cue ball
changelog.r1011.5: Linkpearl has been rebuilt around one chat list: search, filters, pinning and muting, and a new-chat sheet with Free Company, Linkshell, Party and Local presets
changelog.r1011.6: Linkpearl conversations can pop out into floating windows that keep chatting while the phone is closed or minimized, and new tells open one on their own when the phone is out of sight
changelog.r1011.7: The minimized phone is now a live capsule: it shows the clock, unread apps, the playing song and any active call, and swells into a card when a notification arrives
changelog.r1011.8: Chip rows that overflow the screen now show paging arrows on either end
changelog.r1008.0: Music now lists live Twitch DJs from XIV Rolladeck on the Live tab, each with the venue they play from and a Teleport button that takes you there through Lifestream, contributed by eggoless
changelog.r1008.1: Links from other people now open a confirmation first that shows where they lead, with the site name kept whole, before your browser opens: in Chirper, Aethergram, Velvet, ChocoChat, Linkpearl, Announcements, Venues, and Yellow Pages, contributed by Farroness
changelog.r1008.2: Chirper and Aethergram can narrow the For You feed by region: the filter menu gains NA, EU, JP, OCE, and CN toggles, each app remembers its own pick, and the funnel icon dims while any filter is on
changelog.r1008.3: The Aether Coin shop is browsed by category: the Shop tab opens on category tiles wearing their own artwork, a tile opens its shelf, and back returns to the tiles instead of leaving the app
changelog.r1008.4: Polls update on their own the moment one is created, closed, or reopened, and the list can be pulled down to refresh by hand
changelog.r1008.5: MogCast gains a Show In-game Screen switch in its settings, so the screen placed in the world can be hidden while playback carries on, contributed by Farroness
changelog.r1008.6: Icons stay sharp at every size: chess pieces, the icons inside apps, and the icons at the center of progress rings no longer look blurry when drawn large
changelog.r1008.7: Blocking someone in Chirper now also removes their chirps that others rechirped and hides their chirp inside quotes, right away instead of after the next full refresh
changelog.r1008.8: Trivia no longer asks about skills the game has removed, PvP-only actions, or the same skill twice, and its emote questions stick to emotes that can actually be used
changelog.r1008.9: Control Center no longer opens while Camera or MogCast hold the phone in landscape, contributed by Farroness
changelog.r1008.10: The community rules for Chirper, Aethergram, and Velvet have been updated, and they ask to be accepted again on the next open
changelog.r1008.11: Added seven phone cases: Junior Jinbei, Fox Kit, Namazu, Mad Hatter, Cheshire, Alice in Wonderland, and Suzaku, contributed by Silkie, starpanda, kukkiineko, and tatoz
changelog.r1005.0: The Casino and Aether Coin are available again on the Chinese game version
changelog.r1004.0: Velvet and veiled posts are available again on the Chinese game version
changelog.r1003.0: The phone now tells you when an avatar frame is given to you or taken away, instead of the ring around your avatar changing in silence
changelog.r1003.1: Two new frames in the Aether Coin shop
changelog.r1003.2: Added a terms of service and a privacy policy, both linked from the project page
changelog.r1003.4: Fixed the artist credit on three phone cases: Cosmic EX and Caduceus are Zivyl's work, and Runic is Remi's
changelog.r1003.3: A few more changes specific to the Chinese game version
changelog.r1002.0: A few changes specific to the Chinese game version
changelog.r1001.0: Fixed the phone failing to load for some people after updating: when AetherStream cannot attach to the game's display, the phone now starts normally instead of taking the whole plugin down with it
changelog.r1001.1: A missing font file no longer leaves the phone without any text: the phone falls back to the game's own font until the file is back
changelog.r1000.68: Added Gamba, a new play-money casino app: coins become chips at the cashier and the whole floor plays on them, from blackjack at shared tables to live bingo rooms, a communal wheel, slots, scratch cards, a bar shift, and a free daily spin; every round is provably fair, history keeps every stake and payout, loss limits come from both the house and you, and no real money is involved anywhere
changelog.r1000.69: Added Aether Coin, the currency of the Aethernet: checking in daily, playing the arcade, holding real calls and conversations, and posting things that stay up all earn coins, the wallet tracks your goals, streaks, and every earning rule, the coin shop sells frames and badges, and your balance shows in Control Center and on a home screen widget
changelog.r1000.70: Added MogCast, a video app that plays a link on a screen you place in the world: paste a URL or pick a file from your PC, queue what comes next, and hold watch parties where the host approves who joins and everyone lands on the same moment
changelog.r1000.71: Added support for the Chinese game client: the phone now detects it, adapts what it offers, and signs in with a Rising Stones code instead of the Lodestone
changelog.r1000.72: Added photos and GIFs to Chirper: a chirp can carry up to four photos or one animated GIF that plays right in the feed, tapping a photo opens it full screen, sharing one from Photos opens the composer with it attached, and a switch beside the feed hides media chirps if you would rather read text
changelog.r1000.78: Added hashtags to Chirper and Aethergram: write #tags in a chirp, a caption, or a comment, and tapping one opens a feed of every post carrying that tag
changelog.r1000.79: Added photos and GIFs to comments in Aethergram and Chirper: attach one from your gallery or your PC, it shows right in the thread with GIFs playing in place, and a comment can be just the picture with no words at all
changelog.r1000.80: Added animated GIFs to Aethergram: a GIF posts on its own without the crop step and plays in the feed, on the post page, and in the full screen viewer
changelog.r1000.73: Added three phone cases: Allagan, Garlean, and Gurren Lagann, contributed by Zivyl and daitomata
changelog.r1000.74: Rebuilt Linkpearl around conversations: every game text channel from say and shout to party, free company, novice network, and all sixteen linkshells lands in one list, tabs are yours to build, tint, and pin, every link the game puts in a chat line is tappable again with the game's own actions, history is kept and searchable per conversation, and Contacts and Find People merge into one People tab
changelog.r1000.75: Fixed notification banners and cards wrapping their body text onto a second line instead of trimming it
changelog.r1000.76: Fixed text collapsing into a column of single letters while one screen slides out and another slides in
changelog.r1000.77: Fixed the like heart on your own short comments in Aethergram crowding the bottom edge instead of sitting centered
changelog.r1000.15: Aether Coin, Shortcuts, and Housing now have their own welcome tours
changelog.r1000.20: The author of a post can now remove any comment left on it, in Aethergram, Chirper, and Velvet
changelog.r1000.21: Velvet and Message can now delete a conversation, which only Aethergram could before: right click the row in the inbox, and it clears the thread for you alone while the other person keeps theirs
changelog.r1000.22: Tapping a profile photo in a notifications list now opens that person's profile, contributed by Farroness
changelog.r1000.23: Music is now split into four tabs, Home, Live, Radio, and Library, so live community stations are no longer buried under a scroll
changelog.r1000.24: A community station now opens a full page with its artwork, the track playing right now, and a notify button while the station is off air
changelog.r1000.25: The phone case picker is now a store: cases sit in Colors, Gradients, and Custom Artwork rails, and each one opens a page with a full size preview and its artist credit
changelog.r1000.27: The Search the Market entry in the game's right click menu can now be switched off in Behavior settings, contributed by Farroness
changelog.r1000.28: The Discord invite now sits on the settings root under Support Aetherphone, instead of two taps down in About
changelog.r1000.29: App tile colors are now generated from one color ring, so the home screen no longer mixes vivid tiles with dull ones
changelog.r1000.30: The side, mute, and lock buttons now sit seated in the chassis edge instead of floating beside it
changelog.r1000.31: Velvet profile photos now sit directly beneath the about section
changelog.r1000.32: A call now warns you when your microphone never reaches the other side, and points at the input device setting
changelog.r1000.33: A device without your encryption key now locks and asks for your recovery code, instead of quietly creating a new key
changelog.r1000.34: Your recovery code now brings back history encrypted under a previous key, right after unlocking or through Restore older chats in Settings
changelog.r1000.35: Chats now nudge you once to set up a recovery code if you have not saved one
changelog.r1000.36: A PC that cannot use the system key store now keeps your encryption key instead of creating a new one every session
changelog.r1000.37: Conversation previews and message notifications no longer show the encrypted placeholder: previews heal within seconds, and notifications wait for the text to decrypt
changelog.r1000.38: Reordering gearsets and categories in Jobs now uses up and down buttons, replacing drag handles that rarely picked a row up
changelog.r1000.39: Failures that used to pass silently, in playback, imports, saving settings, network requests, and encryption, are now written to the log so problem reports can be traced
changelog.r1000.40: Fixed apps opening wherever you last scrolled: every app now starts at the top, and a chat opens on its newest message
changelog.r1000.41: Fixed pressing close in a story counting as a tap that skipped ahead, and tapping the avatar or the name now opens that person's profile
changelog.r1000.42: Fixed the dynamic island clipping the signal bars, contributed by Farroness
changelog.r1000.43: Fixed Moderation and safety truncating in Settings, and cut two group footers that repeated the rows above them
changelog.r1000.51: Photos can now be marked sensitive: the author sets it while posting or later from the post menu, and everyone else sees a veil until they tap. A veiled photo is never downloaded before you look, reveals last one phone session, and Settings carries an always show switch
changelog.r1000.52: Added avatar frames, a ring drawn around your face everywhere on the Aethernet: both feeds, comments, profiles, stories, Velvet, musters, notifications, chats and saved contacts
changelog.r1000.53: Aetherphone now says why a request failed instead of one generic message, with every reason the server can send written out in all nine languages
changelog.r1000.54: A shared location in chat grows a Go there pill, and Housing gains Travel Here, which lands on the ward and the plot rather than the nearest city aetheryte
changelog.r1000.55: Velvet's Not interested list is kept per account now, with its own screen in Velvet settings and a Remove pill that puts a profile back into Discover
changelog.r1000.56: Retainer ventures in Character now carry their own notification toggle on the header bell
changelog.r1000.57: Overhauled Settings as a grouped list: the switches people come here to flip sit in one card at the top, the rest regroups by what it does, Immersion and Behavior merge into General, and the two sound pages merge into Sounds
changelog.r1000.58: First run setup is now five steps with a way back: the profile and the photo become one Create Your Aethernet ID step, and an Appearance step sets light, dark or dynamic before you sign in to anything
changelog.r1000.59: The plugin download is a fifth of what it was: MogCast fetches its two playback components when you first open the app, with their real size and live progress, instead of every install carrying them
changelog.r1000.60: Removal notices now point at the Discord server for an appeal, instead of the Feedback app
changelog.r1000.61: Fixed a comment being thrown away when the send failed, and a block that failed looking like it had worked
changelog.r1000.62: Fixed feeds and inboxes claiming you have nothing when the fetch had actually failed, in Chirper, Aethergram, Velvet Discover, Messages and Announcements
changelog.r1000.63: Fixed Portrait photos being cropped instead of shown whole when you post them, and a post with several photos can now carry a different shape per photo
changelog.r1000.64: Fixed a card reading 10 breaking across two lines in the card games, contributed by Farroness
changelog.r1000.65: Fixed setting up a recovery code failing on some Wine builds
changelog.r1000.66: Fixed a handful of strings falling back to English in the other eight languages, including the wallet badge toggle and the video file type in the file picker
changelog.r1000.81: Fixed Market repeating the same retainer several times for one item, which pushed real listings from other worlds out of the list
changelog.r1000.82: Revamped the Chirper and Aethergram headers: the app name fits again, both apps share one For You and Following strip, new posts start from a floating button, and Activity sits on a bell beside a More menu

coin.ruleChatHint: Send a message to someone in a private chat, up to four people a day

coin.ruleGameDeepHint: Stay in one game for fifteen minutes, up to twice a day
coin.ruleGameFeaturedHint: Finish a session of today's highlighted game
coin.ruleChirpHint: A chirp that stays up for an hour, once a week
coin.ruleGramHint: A gram that stays up for an hour, once a week

coin.rulePostHint: One chirp or gram that stays up for an hour, once a day
coin.ruleCommentsDailyHint: Comments on other people's posts that stay up for an hour, up to three authors a day

casino.cabinetSoonHint: This game is still being wired up. It arrives in a coming update.

casino.fairness.intro: Every game here is dealt from a sealed seed, and for 7 days you can check settled rounds yourself, right on this phone. Here is how it works.
casino.fairness.lockBody: Before a stake is accepted, Gamba publishes a fingerprint of the round's secret seed. The outcome is fixed in that seed; nothing after your tap can bend it.
casino.fairness.revealBody: When the round settles, the seed itself is revealed. Hash it and it must match the fingerprint published up front, bit for bit.
casino.fairness.replayBody: Your phone re-derives every draw the round logged from the revealed seed, and each one has to come out the same. The check runs here, not at the house.
casino.fairness.chainNote: Every round also carries the sealed fingerprint of the round after it, so the chain never breaks.

casino.originals.pitchMines: Pick safe tiles on a five by five board. Every safe pick raises the multiplier, so cash out before a mine finds you.
casino.originals.pitchDice: Set your win chance, roll over or under it, and win the multiplier that chance pays.
casino.originals.pitchLimbo: Name a target multiplier. The result climbs and stops, and it pays when it reaches your target.
casino.originals.pitchKeno: Pick up to ten numbers, watch ten get drawn, and let your hits decide the payout.
casino.originals.pitchHiLo: Call the next card higher or lower, build a chain of wins, and cash out whenever you like.
casino.originals.rulesMinesStep1: Choose how many mines hide on the board, from 1 to 24, and place your bet.
casino.originals.rulesMinesStep2: Tap tiles one at a time. Every safe tile moves you one step up the multiplier ladder.
casino.originals.rulesMinesStep3: Cash out after any safe pick to take your bet times the multiplier.
casino.originals.rulesMinesStep4: A mine ends the round with no payout. Clearing every safe tile cashes out for you.
casino.originals.rulesDiceStep1: Drag the slider or type a win chance between 0.01% and 98%.
casino.originals.rulesDiceStep2: Choose Roll over or Roll under. The multiplier is 99 divided by your win chance.
casino.originals.rulesDiceStep3: The roll lands between 0.00 and 100.00. Land in the lit zone to win.
casino.originals.rulesLimboStep1: Type a target multiplier between 1.01x and 1,000,000x.
casino.originals.rulesLimboStep2: The result climbs from 1.00x and stops on the number the server drew.
casino.originals.rulesLimboStep3: When the result reaches your target, you win your bet times the target.
casino.originals.rulesKenoStep1: Pick 1 to 10 numbers on the board, or let Auto pick choose them.
casino.originals.rulesKenoStep2: Choose a risk table: Classic, Low, Medium or High. The payout row shows what each hit count pays.
casino.originals.rulesKenoStep3: Ten numbers are drawn. Every pick that is drawn is a hit.
casino.originals.rulesKenoStep4: Your hits set the multiplier from the table you chose.
casino.originals.rulesHiLoStep1: Place a bet and the first card turns up. Aces are low and kings are high.
casino.originals.rulesHiLoStep2: Call whether the next card is higher or lower. Each button shows its chance and multiplier.
casino.originals.rulesHiLoStep3: Every right call multiplies your chain. Skip a card to see the next one at no cost.
casino.originals.rulesHiLoStep4: Cash out after any winning call. A wrong call ends the round with no payout.

casino.race.rules1: Every race runs eight birds. The tote board shows each bird's odds, place odds, last five finishes and how many players back it.
casino.race.rules2: Pick a ticket: Win (first home), Place (in the first three), Forecast (first and second in that order) or Reverse forecast (first two in either order).
casino.race.rules3: Betting closes a minute after the field is shown. The finishing order is drawn from a committed seed the moment bets close, and the race you watch is built from it.
casino.race.rules4: Up to six tickets a race. Odds are fixed when the field is shown, and a ticket pays its stake times its odds.

casino.plinko.rulesStep1: Pick 8, 12 or 16 rows and a risk of Low, Medium or High. The slots along the bottom show what each one pays.
casino.plinko.rulesStep2: Place your bet and drop. The ball bounces left or right at every row, and the server draws every bounce before it falls.
casino.plinko.rulesStep3: The slot it lands in multiplies your bet. The middle pays least; the edges pay the most and land the least.
casino.plinko.rulesStep4: Drop as often as you like: up to ten balls fall at once. Every board pays back about 99%.

casino.slots.bird.pitch: Five reels, ten lines and free spins where one symbol expands to fill its reels.
casino.slots.cascade.pitch: Eight or more of a kind anywhere pay, winners shatter and the rest tumble down.
casino.slots.moogle.pitch: Six pom coins lock for hold and spin, and a full grid pays the Grand.
casino.slots.bird.rules1: Pick your bet. It covers all ten lines, and line wins pay left to right from the first reel.
casino.slots.bird.rules2: Three or more suns anywhere pay and start 10 free spins.
casino.slots.bird.rules3: One symbol is picked for the feature. When it lands on three or more reels, those reels fill with it and it pays on every line.
casino.slots.bird.rules4: After a win under 20 times the bet you can gamble it on red or black, up to five times.
casino.slots.cascade.rules1: Pick your bet. Eight or more of the same symbol anywhere on the grid pay.
casino.slots.cascade.rules2: Winners shatter and new symbols tumble in. Each tumble in a row raises the multiplier 1x, 2x, 3x, then 5x.
casino.slots.cascade.rules3: Four or more crystal stars start 10 free spins. In free spins, orbs on a winning spin add to a total that multiplies the win.
casino.slots.cascade.rules4: Ante Bet costs a quarter more and brings the bonus about twice as often. Bonus Buy starts the free spins for 100 times the bet.
casino.slots.moogle.rules1: Pick your bet. It covers all ten lines, and pom coins can land on any cell.
casino.slots.moogle.rules2: Six or more coins lock and give 3 respins. Every new coin resets the respins to 3.
casino.slots.moogle.rules3: Coins pay their values, Mini and Minor pay their meters, Major pays 500x, and all 15 cells pay the Grand 2,000x on top.
casino.slots.moogle.rules4: Three wings on the middle reels start 6 free games with a giant symbol, and a giant coin counts as nine coins.
casino.slots.bird.ruleFree: Three or more suns award 10 free spins on their own reels. One symbol, never the wild, is drawn for the whole feature; whenever it shows on three or more reels, those reels fill with it and it pays its line pay on all ten lines. Three more suns add 10 spins, up to 60.
casino.slots.bird.ruleGamble: Gamble: a win above zero and under 20 times the bet can be risked on a fair red or black card. A match doubles it, a miss loses it, and you can go again up to five times. Collect any time by spinning again.
casino.slots.cascade.ruleTumble: Every symbol with 8 or more on the grid pays in bands of 8 to 9, 10 to 11 and 12 or more. Winners shatter, everything else falls, and new symbols fill the gaps. In the base game each tumble in a row is multiplied 1x, 2x, 3x, then 5x.
casino.slots.cascade.ruleFree: Four or more crystal stars pay and award 10 free spins. Orbs worth 2x to 500x land only in free spins; when a spin wins, its orbs join a feature total that multiplies that spin. Three stars add 5 spins, up to 50.
casino.slots.moogle.ruleHold: Each cell can land a pom coin worth 1x to 50x the bet, or Mini, Minor or Major. Six or more start hold and spin: coins lock, 3 respins, each new coin resets them to 3. It ends when the respins run out or all 15 cells hold a coin, which adds the Grand.
casino.slots.moogle.ruleGames: Three wings on reels 2 to 4 start 6 free games. In each, one giant symbol covers the middle reels; a giant coin is nine coins and always starts hold and spin. Mini and Minor grow with every spin at your bet and must hit before they reach their ceiling.

casino.dealerholdem.pitch: Hold'em heads up against the dealer. Bet big when you like your cards; the dealer needs a pair to qualify.
casino.dealerholdem.rulesStep1: Put down an Ante; the Blind matches it. Add the Trips side bet if you like.
casino.dealerholdem.rulesStep2: Before the flop, check or bet 3x or 4x your Ante. After the flop, check or bet 2x. After the river, bet 1x or fold.
casino.dealerholdem.rulesStep3: You make one Play bet per hand. Once you bet, the rest of the board is dealt and the dealer turns over.
casino.dealerholdem.rulesStep4: Beat the dealer and Play pays 1 to 1. Ante pays 1 to 1 when the dealer has a pair or better, and pushes when they do not.
casino.dealerholdem.rulesStep5: Blind pays on a winning straight or better and pushes on a smaller win. Trips pays on your final hand, even if you fold.

casino.dealerholdem.blindPushNote: A win below a straight pushes the Blind.

hunts.guideHowItWorksBody:
Each mark has a preset window it can spawn in after its last death. A spawn moment gets picked somewhere inside that window, and the mark can only spawn when its condition is met once that moment has passed.

By tracking these windows, along with when marks spawn and die, we can effectively track every S-rank across every world.

Note that for most marks this isn't random: a window shown at 60% means there's a 60% chance the mark is currently active, not a 60% chance that it will spawn.
hunts.guideRanksBody:
F-rank marks, often called FATE marks, come at the end of long FATE chains and only spawn every few hours or days.

B-rank marks are weekly hunt marks. They respawn 5 seconds after the last one is killed, so they're essentially always up.

A-rank marks are rare targets that respawn every few hours with no conditions. They're usually killed together as part of a Hunt Train, a group that works through every A-rank in an expansion. For Stormblood and older expansions, Hunt Trains are rare and marks are typically free-for-all.

S-rank marks have a specific window and only spawn once their condition is met. They're tracked on Faloop and spawn at most every few days.
hunts.guideWindowStatusTitle: What do the window statuses mean?
hunts.guideWindowStatusBody:
Closed means the mark is certainly outside its window.
Open means there's a chance the mark is active.
Capped means it has reached the end of its window and is certainly active, unless it was sniped.
Unmet means the window is active, but the mark's spawn condition depends on other factors, like weather, time, or moon phase, that aren't currently in place.
hunts.guideSSMarksBody: Every time an S-rank mark dies on a post-Shadowbringers map, there's a chance for 4 minions to spawn. Killing those minions in time spawns a special SS-rank mark, which gives more drops.
hunts.guideAffiliationBody: No. Aetherphone is an independent, unofficial client, it is not made, run, sponsored, or endorsed by Faloop in any way. It simply displays hunt data pulled from Faloop's public service. Please send feedback about this app to Aetherphone, not to Faloop.
hunts.guideContributeTitle: How can I contribute to hunt tracking?
hunts.guideContributeBody:
This app is an independent client that displays hunt data from Faloop's own tracking project. To contribute reports, or to learn more about Faloop itself, join their Discord:

https://discord.gg/faloop
hunts.guideScheduledBody: Accounts with reporting permissions on Faloop may see some marks as Scheduled. This means a reporter has reported the spawn but hasn't made it public yet. Please respect their decision and wait until the mark is public before advertising it.
hunts.guideMaintenanceTitle: How do maintenances affect mark windows?
hunts.guideMaintenanceBody:
When maintenance happens and the servers restart, every mark's timer resets to zero, and its window then follows the post-maintenance timing instead of the normal one.

Note that a server crash doesn't always reset S-rank timers, the backend may have stayed up even if players got disconnected.
hunts.guideUnlockBody:
Hunts unlock through a series of quests, one set per expansion, usually starting partway through that expansion's main scenario. For the full breakdown of every unlock quest, see the wiki:

https://ffxiv.consolegameswiki.com/wiki/The_Hunt#Unlock
hunts.guideSpawnConditionsTitle: How do people figure out the spawn conditions?
hunts.guideSpawnConditionsBody:
Each area has a specific NPC who shares lore about its S-ranks, and that lore usually hints at how to spawn them.

For example, Agrippa's lore mentions a hunter being ambushed after searching for treasure, hinting that its spawn condition is opening a treasure map.
hunts.guideGlossaryBody:
Conductor: Person who leads a Hunt Train.
ET/EzT: Eorzean Time. Pulls are usually scheduled in Eorzean time rather than real-world time.
Landmine: One of the spots where a mark can spawn.
PT: Pull Time, the moment the mark will be attacked and killed.
Scouter: Person who locates an A-rank mark ahead of a Hunt Train.
Sniping: Killing a hunt mark without reporting it. Sniping is completely permitted, but is generally considered poor etiquette.
Spawner/Reporter: Person who first reports a mark's spawn.
Train: An organized event where players kill every A-rank mark in an expansion, typically Shadowbringers or later.
tyfs: Thank You For Spawn, a common way to thank whoever reported the mark.

hunts.lore.orghana.spawn: May trigger while passing over its spawn locations while the Not Just a Tribute FATE is complete.
hunts.lore.ruminator.spawn: Requires defeating 100 each of Thinkers, Wanderers and Weepers.
hunts.lore.safat.spawn: Requires falling damage that brings a player down to 1 HP.
hunts.lore.sansheya.spawn: Requires three consecutive successful clears of the You Are What You Drink FATE.
hunts.lore.senmurv.spawn: Requires five consecutive successful clears of the Cerf's Up FATE.
hunts.lore.sphatika.spawn: Requires defeating 100 each of Asvattha, Pisaca and Vajralangula.
hunts.lore.tarchia.spawn: May trigger when a player uses Self Destruct on a spawn location.
hunts.lore.the_forecaster.spawn: May trigger when a player casts Northerlies on a spawn location.
hunts.lore.the_garlok.spawn: Requires 200 real-time minutes without rain or showers in the zone.
hunts.lore.the_pale_rider.spawn: May trigger when a treasure map chest is opened.
hunts.lore.thousand_cast_theda.spawn: May trigger after successfully landing a Judgeray.
hunts.lore.tyger.spawn: Requires discarding a single Rail Tenderloin.
hunts.lore.zona_seeker.spawn: May trigger after successfully landing a Glimmerscale.
hunts.lore.battlecraftOrGcLevequest.spaw: May trigger the moment a Battlecraft or Grand Company levequest is started.
hunts.lore.archaeotania.spawn: Requires clearing two separate FATE chains in The Tempest.
hunts.lore.chi.spawn: Requires clearing two FATEs in Ultima Thule.
hunts.lore.daivadipa.spawn: Requires clearing two FATEs in Thavnair.
hunts.lore.formidable.spawn: Requires clearing two FATEs in Kholusia.
hunts.lore.mica_the_magical_mu.spawn: Requires clearing two FATEs in Living Memory.
hunts.lore.tamamo_gozen.spawn: Requires clearing three FATEs in Yanxia.
hunts.lore.ttokrrone.spawn: Requires clearing four FATEs in Shaaloani.
hunts.lore.noSpecificSpawnTrigger.spawn: Has no distinct trigger, it spawns at a random point once its window opens.

nameplate.title: Nameplate Title
nameplate.notInstalledBody: Nameplate Title shows what you are doing as your title through the Honorific plugin. Install Honorific from the Dalamud plugin installer, then come back here.
nameplate.enabled: Show my status on my title
nameplate.publicHint: Everyone who sees your Honorific title sees this, including friends who sync with you. When nothing is active, your own title comes back.
nameplate.nothingActive: Nothing to show right now, so your own title is on.
nameplate.statusesHint: The first active status from the top shows on your title. Use the arrows to change the order, and tap a status to edit its text.
nameplate.mogCastHint: Your party code, while the party is open to guests.
nameplate.jamHint: The join code, while you host a jam.
nameplate.radioHint: Your station, while you DJ live.
nameplate.musterHint: The meetup type, while a meetup you host is running.
nameplate.socialAppsHint: Your handle in this app, while it is open.
nameplate.velvetHint: Your Velvet handle, while Velvet is open. Anyone who can see your title sees it, Velvet user or not.
nameplate.inCallHint: While you are on a call.
nameplate.dndHint: While Do Not Disturb is on.
nameplate.pcMediaHint: Turn on Show Windows media in Settings > Apps > Music first.
nameplate.takeTurnsHint: A line that does not fit shows the song and artist one at a time, and long names show in parts. Nothing gets cut off.
nameplate.shortenHint: A line that does not fit drops the artist first, then cuts the song name short.
nameplate.linePlaceholder: Another line, like I am listening to
nameplate.linesHint: Each line shows on its own, one after another. Leave them empty to use the default text.
nameplate.handleHint: Your handle, when nothing above it is active.
nameplate.customHint: Your own words. Put it at the top to always show it.
nameplate.textHint: Leave it empty to use the default text.
nameplate.styleAppHint: Each status takes the color of the app it comes from.
nameplate.styleMineHint: Copies the color, glow and gradient of your own Honorific title.
nameplate.styleMineMissing: Set a custom title in Honorific first. Until then, app colors are used.
nameplate.gamesHint: The game you are playing, while it is open.
nameplate.gambaSlotsHint: A spin result takes the place of Gamba for a few seconds after it lands.
